title: X-ray timing not covered
plain: The X-ray was either taken more than 12 months ago or too far from the start of treatment to be covered.
action: Check the X-ray date and treatment start; rebill only if it meets timing rules.

title: Inpatient service not separately paid
plain: This service is not payable separately because the patient was an inpatient; it is included in the inpatient payment.
action: Do not bill it separately; include it with the inpatient claim or adjust the charge.

title: Similar equipment already in use
plain: The equipment billed is the same as or similar to equipment the patient is already using.
action: Verify whether replacement or change is documented; otherwise do not bill as new equipment.

title: Final DME installment payment
plain: The payer is making the last monthly installment payment on this durable medical equipment, so payments for it end after this.
action: No action needed — this is informational; just note that installment payments for this equipment have ended.

title: DME rental payment cap
plain: Rental payments may continue through the earlier of the 15th month from the first rental month or the month the equipment is no longer needed.
action: Track the rental start month and stop billing when the cap or need ends.

title: Furnish equipment for useful lifetime
plain: You must continue to furnish and service the equipment for any period of medical need for its remaining reasonable useful lifetime.
action: Continue furnishing and servicing the equipment as required during its useful lifetime.

title: No rental after purchase or cap
plain: No rental payments are allowed after the equipment is purchased, returned, or once total rental payments equal the purchase price.
action: Stop rental billing when any of these conditions occur and bill appropriately.

title: Blood gas test restrictions
plain: Blood gas tests are not accepted if a medical supplier performed them or if the patient was on oxygen during the test.
action: Confirm the test was not supplier-performed or done on oxygen; resubmit valid results.

title: Tenth rental month purchase option
plain: The equipment has reached its tenth rental month, so the supplier must give the patient the option to switch from renting to buying it.
action: Offer the purchase option and document the patient's choice.

title: Equipment purchase month limits
plain: Equipment purchases are covered only in the first or tenth month of medical necessity.
action: Bill a purchase only in the first or tenth month; otherwise use rental billing.

title: Bill DME to ZIP carrier
plain: Claims for DME, orthotics, and prosthetics must go to the DME carrier (DME MAC) responsible for the patient's ZIP code.
action: Submit the claim to the correct DME MAC for the patient's ZIP code.

title: Diagnostic test purchased services indicator
plain: When a physician bills a diagnostic test, the claim must state whether any purchased services are included.
action: Add the purchased-services indicator to the claim.

title: One initial visit per specialty
plain: The plan covers just one initial visit for each specialty within the same medical group; later visits are billed as established-patient visits.
action: Bill only one initial visit per specialty/group; use established visit codes for later visits.

title: Injection bundled with office visit
plain: An injection given during an office visit isn't paid separately, and if the visit was only for the injection, the payer won't pay for a full office visit.
action: Do not bill the injection separately with an E/M; bill the appropriate service.

title: Services bundled same procedure
plain: The payer combined these separately billed services or tests into a single procedure because they're treated as parts of it, so they can't be paid individually.
action: Combine the services into the primary procedure and remove separate charges.

title: More policy details available
plain: This is an alert that more details about the payer's policy, procedure, or decision are available. Review the payer's website, mailings, or bulletins for the specifics.
action: Review the payer's website, mailings, or bulletins for details.

title: Payment approved despite coverage doubt
plain: Payment was approved because you had no way of knowing this service would not normally be covered for this patient. Going forward, you will be liable for charges for the same services provided under the same or similar conditions.
action: Verify coverage before providing the same service under similar conditions in the future.

title: Home use excludes hospital/SNF
plain: Certain services may be covered for home use, but a hospital or skilled nursing facility is not considered the patient's home. Confirm the service was furnished in an eligible home setting.
action: Verify the service was provided in an eligible home setting before billing.

title: Missing oxygen certification/re-certification
plain: The claim is missing the required oxygen certification or recertification. Obtain the necessary documentation to support oxygen coverage.
action: Obtain and submit the required oxygen certification or recertification.

title: Missing or invalid HCPCS
plain: The HCPCS code for this service or item is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The claim needs a valid HCPCS code to be processed.
action: Correct or add a valid HCPCS code on the claim.

title: Missing home residence information
plain: The place of residence is missing, incomplete, or invalid for a service or item provided in the patient's home. Submit the patient's valid home residence information.
action: Submit the patient's complete and valid place of residence.

title: Missing or invalid mileage
plain: The number of miles traveled is missing, incomplete, or invalid for this claim. Provide the correct mileage so the claim can be reviewed.
action: Provide the correct number of miles traveled.

title: Missing required invoice
plain: The payer needs an invoice that was not included with the claim. Submit the missing invoice to support the payment.
action: Send the missing invoice to the payer.

title: Missing doses per vial
plain: The number of doses per vial is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Submit the correct dose-per-vial information.
action: Submit the correct number of doses per vial.

title: Service level not substantiated
plain: The information submitted does not support the need for the level of service billed. You may ask the payer to review the claim within 120 days of this notice — for example, if you believe the billed level should be covered, or you had the patient's advance written agreement to pay. If you do not appeal, the payer will, at the patient's request, reimburse the patient any amounts you collected beyond the deductible and coinsurance, then recover that payment from you as an overpayment.
action: Appeal within 120 days if documentation supports the billed level of service or you had the patient's written agreement to pay.

title: Refund patient within 30 days
plain: The documentation does not support the level of service billed. If you collected patient amounts for this level or more than the limiting charge for a less extensive service, you must refund the patient within 30 days.
action: Refund any overcollected patient amounts within 30 days if applicable.

title: Provider liable; patient relieved
plain: The patient is relieved from payment under the limitation-of-liability rule, and the provider is liable for waived charges, including coinsurance, because the services were not reasonable and necessary or were custodial care and you knew or should have known they were not covered. You may appeal the coverage and due-care determinations within 120 days through this office.
action: File an appeal within 120 days if you disagree with the coverage or due-care determination.

title: No Part B when Part A unavailable
plain: Because the patient's Part A benefits are exhausted or otherwise unavailable, this item or service also cannot be paid under Part B.
action: Confirm the patient's Part A status and Part B eligibility before resubmitting the claim.

title: Missing operative note/report
plain: The operative note or report needed to review the claim was not included. Submit the missing operative documentation.
action: Submit the missing operative note or report.

title: Missing pathology report
plain: The pathology report needed to review the claim was not included. Submit the missing pathology report.
action: Submit the missing pathology report.

title: Missing radiology report
plain: The radiology report was not included with the claim. The payer needs it to review the service.
action: Submit the missing radiology report.

title: Conditional payment pending primary payer
plain: This payment is being made on a conditional basis while the patient's primary payer decides on the service. If another payer pays later, this payment may need to be refunded.
action: Contact the payer immediately if another payer pays for this service.

title: 11th rental month purchase option
plain: The equipment has reached its 11th rental month. Payment is on hold until you confirm the patient was offered the option to convert the rental into a purchase.
action: Notify the payer that the patient was given the rent-to-purchase option so payment can be released.

title: Not covered under age 35
plain: This service is not covered for patients who have not yet turned 35.
action: Confirm the patient's date of birth. If the patient is under 35, the service is not covered by this payer; check whether the patient or another payer can be billed.

title: Patient liable after written notice
plain: The patient is responsible for these charges because they were told in writing before the service that it would not be covered and the patient agreed to pay.
action: You may bill the patient according to the signed agreement.

title: Patient not liable due notice issue
plain: The patient is not responsible for these charges because the advance non-coverage notice you gave did not follow program requirements.
action: Do not bill the patient; review your advance notice process.

title: Must be assigned and employer filed
plain: The claim must be submitted under assignment and must be filed by the practitioner's employer, not by the practitioner as an individual.
action: Have the practitioner's employer file the claim on an assigned basis.

title: No payment no patient liability
plain: The payer will not pay for this service because the patient has no legal obligation to pay for it.
action: Do not bill the patient; review the charge for adjustment.

title: Medical necessity form signature missing
plain: The medical necessity form requires the attending physician's own signature; a stamp or a signature made by someone else on the physician's behalf is not acceptable.
action: Have the attending physician personally sign the form, then resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid condition code
plain: A condition code — a code that identifies special circumstances affecting the claim — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the condition code and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid occurrence code
plain: An occurrence code — a code that identifies a significant event and its date — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the occurrence code(s) and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid occurrence span code
plain: An occurrence span code — a code that identifies an event covering a span of dates — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the occurrence span code(s) and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid claim control number
plain: The payer's claim control number — the unique number the payer assigned to the original claim — is missing, incomplete, or invalid. It may also be called an Internal Control Number (ICN), Claim Control Number (CCN), or Document Control Number (DCN).
action: Find the control number on the original claim's remittance advice and include it on the corrected claim.

title: Missing or invalid value code
plain: A value code — a code used to report a specific dollar amount or value tied to the claim — or its amount is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the value code(s) and amount(s), then resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid revenue code
plain: A revenue code — the code that identifies the department or type of service being billed — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the revenue code(s) and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid procedure code
plain: The claim is missing a procedure code, or the code submitted is incomplete or invalid.
action: Correct and resubmit the claim with a valid procedure code.

title: Missing or invalid service start date
plain: The "from" date of service is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct "from" date of service.

title: Missing or invalid service units
plain: The days or units billed for the service are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Enter the correct days or units and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid total charges
plain: The total charge amount on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct the total charges and resubmit the claim.

title: Self-administered anti-emetic not covered
plain: This self-administered anti-emetic drug is not payable because it was not administered with a covered oral anti-cancer drug.
action: Verify whether a covered oral anti-cancer drug was also administered; if not, treat the drug as non-covered.

title: Missing or invalid payer identifier
plain: The payer identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add the correct payer identifier and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid service end date
plain: The "to" date of service is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct "to" date of service.

title: Missing Certificate of Medical Necessity
plain: A required Certificate of Medical Necessity was not submitted with the claim.
action: Obtain and submit the required Certificate of Medical Necessity.

title: FDA clinical trial approval expired
plain: This service is not payable because the FDA clinical trial it was part of is past its approved period.
action: Confirm the trial's approval dates; if the approval period has lapsed, the claim cannot be paid.

title: Missing or invalid authorization code
plain: The treatment authorization code is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Obtain and submit the correct treatment authorization code.

title: Missing or invalid other diagnosis
plain: An "other" diagnosis on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the other diagnosis and resubmit.

title: One interpreting physician per claim
plain: When a purchased diagnostic test is indicated, only one interpreting physician charge can be submitted per claim, so each interpreting physician needs a separate claim.
action: Submit a separate claim for each interpreting physician.

title: Split technical and professional components
plain: The diagnostic test is subject to price limitations, but the submitted procedure code included a professional component; only the technical component is price-limited.
action: Submit the technical and professional components as separate line items.

title: Missing or invalid other procedure code
plain: An "other" procedure code on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the other procedure code and resubmit.

title: Modified procedure code not documented
plain: The claim was paid at the regular rate because documentation was not submitted to justify the modified procedure code.
action: Submit documentation supporting the modified procedure code if the modification was appropriate.

title: NDC translated to HCPCS
plain: The NDC you submitted was converted to a HCPCS code for processing. Keep submitting the NDC for this item on future claims.
action: Continue submitting the NDC on future claims for this item.

title: Overlapping tests reduced payment
plain: Payment was reduced because the tests billed overlap with other tests. Review the test overlap before billing.
action: Review overlapping tests and bill only services that are separately payable.

title: HPSA bonus only professional component
plain: An HPSA or physician scarcity bonus applies only to the professional portion of this service. To get the bonus, submit a new claim that bills the professional and technical components separately.
action: Submit a corrected claim billing the professional and technical components separately.

title: No HPSA scarcity bonus
plain: This service isn't eligible for the HPSA or physician scarcity bonus, so no bonus amount will be added to the payment.
action: No action — informational.

title: Same-day multichannel tests combined
plain: Several automated multichannel tests run on the same day were grouped together and paid as one combined service.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing or invalid diagnosis
plain: The diagnosis or condition is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Correct the diagnosis information and resubmit the claim.
action: Correct the diagnosis or condition and resubmit the claim.

title: Invalid place of service
plain: The place of service is missing, incomplete, invalid, or inappropriate. Correct the place of service and resubmit.
action: Correct the place of service and resubmit.

title: Invalid or missing charge
plain: The charge is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Provide the correct charge and resubmit the claim.
action: Correct the charge and resubmit.

title: Same session service not covered
plain: Coverage is denied for a service performed during the same session, or on the same date, as another service for this patient that has already been processed.
action: Review the earlier service and bill only if this service is separate and payable.

title: Code to highest specificity
plain: The claim must use codes at the highest level of specificity available. Review and correct the coding, then resubmit.
action: Correct codes to the highest specificity and resubmit.

title: Not covered under age 50
plain: Coverage for this service is limited to patients age 50 and older, so it is not paid for younger patients. Verify the patient's age and coverage.
action: Verify patient age and resubmit only if coverage criteria are met.

title: Coverage requires high-risk patient
plain: Coverage applies only when the patient is classified as high risk. Document the high-risk classification if it applies.
action: Document high-risk status and resubmit if the patient qualifies.

title: Use date-of-service code set
plain: All codes on the claim must come from the code sets that were in effect on the date the service was provided. Check the codes against the version effective for that date and resubmit.
action: Use the code set effective on the date of service and resubmit.

title: E/M services under review
plain: The physician evaluation and management services are subject to review. Provide supporting documentation if requested.
action: Submit documentation if requested for the E/M review.

title: Duplicate within time frame
plain: The claim was denied because the payer already paid for the same or a similar procedure performed within a defined time period. Check the prior payment before rebilling.
action: Review the prior payment; do not rebill unless the service is distinct and appealable.

title: Prepayment review by CFO-CAP
plain: This claim or service is under CFO-CAP prepayment review before payment is made.
action: Respond to any documentation request from the review.

title: Covered once before age 40
plain: This service is not covered if it has already been provided once before the patient turns 40.
action: Verify the patient's age and prior service history before billing again.

title: Once per 12-month period only
plain: This service is not covered if it was already provided within the last 12 months.
action: Check the prior service date and bill only if the 12-month interval has passed.

title: Separate claims for different CLIA numbers
plain: Laboratory services performed under different CLIA certification numbers cannot be combined on one claim; each CLIA number requires its own separate claim submission.
action: Split the lab procedures by CLIA number and resubmit on separate claims.

title: Break in therapy starts new rental
plain: The information supports a break in therapy, so a new capped rental period began when this equipment was delivered.
action: Bill according to the new capped rental period.

title: No break in therapy, rental continues
plain: The documentation does not demonstrate a break in therapy, so the existing capped rental period stays in effect and no new one will start.
action: Do not start a new capped rental period; continue the existing rental period.

title: Home Health Initiative medical review audit
plain: These services are subject to medical review or a cost report audit under the Home Health Initiative.
action: Provide requested records and monitor the audit outcome.

title: Inpatient technical component facility-only billing
plain: For an inpatient, only the inpatient facility may bill the technical component; the practitioner should bill only the professional component if it has not already been billed.
action: Contact the inpatient facility for technical component reimbursement and bill the professional component only.

title: Practitioner not paid in facility setting
plain: This service is not paid to the practitioner when provided to a patient in this place of service because payment is included in the facility's reimbursement.
action: Seek reimbursement from the facility, since the payment it receives already includes this service.

title: Missing or invalid product/serial number
plain: The claim is missing a valid Universal Product Number or Serial Number, or the submitted one is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit the correct Universal Product Number or Serial Number.

title: Oral anti-emetic timing coverage rule
plain: Oral anti-emetic drugs are not paid unless administered for use immediately before, at, or within 48 hours after covered chemotherapy.
action: Verify the anti-emetic was administered within the covered time frame before billing.

title: Service not on FDA-approved equipment
plain: The equipment used to perform this service does not have FDA approval for this particular use, so the service is not payable.
action: Use FDA-approved equipment for this service and correct the claim if needed.

title: Break supported but need reduced
plain: A break in therapy is supported, but the medical information does not support this item as billed; payment is approved at a reduced level and a new capped rental period will begin with delivery.
action: Review the documentation and bill the reduced approved amount under the new capped rental period.

title: New rental period at fee schedule max
plain: The documentation supports a break in therapy, so a new capped rental period starts when the equipment is delivered, and payment has been approved at the highest amount the fee schedule allows for this item or service.
action: Accept the fee schedule maximum and begin the new capped rental period.

title: No break and need reduced
plain: A break in therapy is not supported, the medical information does not support this item as billed, payment is approved at a reduced level, and a new capped rental period will not begin.
action: Review medical necessity, accept the reduced payment, and do not start a new capped rental period.

title: ESRD Hematocrit Rolling Average Too High
plain: The patient's average hematocrit over the past 90 days was above 36.5%. Because of that, the payer cut the payment on this ESRD claim.
action: Review the patient's recent hematocrit results and anemia management with the treating physician; rebilling will not help unless the clinical data changes.

title: Teleconsultation Bundle Split With Referrer
plain: The payer bundled the teleconsultation into one payment. You must send 25% of that payment to the practitioner who referred the patient.
action: Send 25% of the teleconsultation payment to the referring practitioner and document the transfer.

title: Chiropractic Denied Without X-Ray
plain: The payer will not cover chiropractic manipulative treatment when the patient declines to have an x-ray taken.
action: Document the patient's refusal and any clinical justification; the service remains non-covered in this situation.

title: DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Rate Applied
plain: This item was paid using the single competitive bidding amount that applies to the area where the patient lives.
action: No action — informational.

title: Item Started Before Current Bidding Period
plain: The payer's records show the patient started using this item or service before the current DMEPOS competitive bidding contract period began.
action: Verify the start date of use and the applicable bidding period; contact the contractor if your records differ.

title: Processed Under DMEPOS Bidding Program
plain: This service was handled according to the rules of the DMEPOS Competitive Bidding Program or a demonstration project. Your local contractor can answer further questions about those programs.
action: No action — informational.

title: Denied: Non-Contract Supplier
plain: This item is not payable when a supplier who is outside the contract or demonstration program furnishes it to this patient.
action: Confirm whether you are a contracted supplier for the patient's area; if not, the item generally cannot be billed for payment.

title: Demonstration Project Ending
plain: This claim was processed under a demonstration project or program that is ending. Additional services may no longer be paid under it.
action: Check the project's end date and billing guidance before submitting further services under it.

title: Must Be Filed Electronically
plain: This service is not covered unless the claim is submitted electronically.
action: Resubmit the claim electronically.

title: Invalid or Missing Drug Code
plain: The National Drug Code on the claim is missing, incomplete, invalid, deactivated, or withdrawn.
action: Correct the NDC using a current, active code and resubmit the claim.

title: Must Accompany Covered Cryosurgical Ablation
plain: The payer covers this service only when it is performed together with a covered cryosurgical ablation.
action: Verify the cryosurgical ablation was performed and billed, then resubmit with the supporting claim detail.

title: Invalid or Missing Subluxation Level
plain: The claim does not show a valid level of subluxation, or the level reported is incomplete or invalid.
action: Add the correct subluxation level from the treatment documentation and resubmit.

title: Missing Drug Name, Strength, or Dosage
plain: The claim lacks complete and valid details about the drug's name, strength, or dosage.
action: Add the drug name, strength, and dosage as documented and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing Equipment Ownership Information
plain: The claim does not state whether the patient owns the equipment that needs this part or supply.
action: Report whether the patient owns the equipment and send a corrected claim.

title: Missing Length of Need Information
plain: The claim does not include complete and valid information about how long the service, supply, or equipment will be needed.
action: Add the expected period of need from the order or documentation and resubmit.

title: Missing individual lab codes
plain: The individual lab codes included in the test are missing, incomplete, or invalid. Each lab component must be reported with a valid code.
action: Submit the claim with valid individual lab codes for each test component.

title: Missing patient medical record
plain: The patient's medical record for this service is missing. The record is needed to support the claim.
action: Provide the patient's medical record documentation for the service.

title: Missing x-ray availability indicator
plain: The indicator showing whether an x-ray is available for review is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Indicate whether the x-ray is available for review and submit the required information.

title: Missing lens invoice or statement
plain: The claim needs an invoice or statement that proves the actual lens cost after discounts, and/or identifies the type of intraocular lens used. That documentation is missing or invalid.
action: Send the invoice or statement with lens cost, discounts, and intraocular lens type.

title: Missing physician financial relationship form
plain: A physician financial relationship form is required but was not submitted. The form is missing.
action: Submit the completed physician financial relationship form.

title: Missing pacemaker registration form
plain: A pacemaker registration form is required but missing. It must be submitted with the claim.
action: Submit the pacemaker registration form.

title: Missing purchased diagnostic test details
plain: The claim did not identify who performed the purchased diagnostic test or the amount charged for it. Both the performing party and the charge must be reported.
action: Identify the performing provider and the amount charged for the purchased diagnostic test.

title: Financial interest in performing facility
plain: The service was performed by a facility or supplier in which the provider has a financial interest. This is an informational remark.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing plan of treatment
plain: The plan of treatment is missing, incomplete, or invalid. A proper plan is needed.
action: Submit a complete and valid plan of treatment.

title: Missing physician supervision indication
plain: The indication that the service was supervised or evaluated by a physician is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide documentation that the service was supervised or evaluated by a physician.

title: Part B coinsurance for demonstration
plain: This amount is the Part B coinsurance that applies under a demonstration or pilot program. It is a patient responsibility item.
action: No action — informational.

title: Patient not enrolled in demonstration
plain: The patient was flagged as a demonstration participant, but they were not actually enrolled when the service was provided. Only enrolled participants have coverage under the demonstration.
action: Verify demonstration enrollment for the date of service and bill the patient or other coverage if not enrolled.

title: Services exceed demonstration coverage limit
plain: The denied services go beyond the maximum coverage allowed under the demonstration. The demonstration will not pay for services over that limit.
action: Review the demonstration coverage limit and adjust charges or appeal if appropriate.

title: Missing physician certified plan of care
plain: A plan of care certified by a physician is missing. The claim needs the physician-certified plan.
action: Obtain and submit the physician-certified plan of care.

title: Missing ADA Certificate of Recognition
plain: The American Diabetes Association Certificate of Recognition is missing. It must be provided.
action: Submit the American Diabetes Association Certificate of Recognition.

title: Update License Information With Payer
plain: The payer requires you to update the license information it has on file for you.
action: Update license information with the payer.

title: Pre/Post-Op Payment Included in Surgery
plain: The surgery or procedure allowance already covers any related pre-operative and post-operative care.
action: No action — informational; do not bill pre-/post-op care separately.

title: Appeal Rights Within 120 Days
plain: If you disagree with the approved services, you can appeal, but the appeal must be handled by someone who did not process the original claim. You must write within 120 days of receiving this notice unless you have a good reason for being late.
action: File a written appeal within 120 days if you disagree.

title: Appeal Rights Within 180 Days
plain: If you disagree with this decision, you have the right to appeal. You must send a written appeal request within 180 days of receiving this notice.
action: File a written appeal within 180 days if you disagree.

title: Primary Payer Info Needed for Secondary
plain: Secondary payment cannot be considered because the primary payer's identity or payment information was missing or unreadable.
action: Obtain and submit the primary payer's identity and payment information.

title: Claim Forwarded to Medicaid Review
plain: The claim information was also sent to Medicaid for review.
action: No action — informational.

title: Medigap Forwarding Not Available
plain: The claim information was not forwarded because the supplemental coverage is not a Medigap plan, or you do not participate in Medicare.
action: Verify whether the supplemental coverage is Medigap and whether you participate in Medicare.

title: Processed as Assigned Despite Unassigned
plain: You submitted the claim as unassigned, but the payer processed it as assigned under your current assignment or participation agreement.
action: Review your assignment or participation agreement with the payer.

title: Refund Excess Patient Payment
plain: The patient paid more than the amount owed. You must refund the excess to the patient.
action: Refund the overpayment to the patient.

title: Billing Rights Not Established
plain: The payer says you have not shown that you have the legal right to bill for services provided by the person or people who furnished them.
action: Provide documentation showing your legal right to bill for these services.

title: Penalties for Improper Patient Billing
plain: You could face penalties if you bill the patient for amounts that were not reported with the PR patient responsibility group code.
action: Do not bill the patient for amounts not reported under the PR group code.

title: Non-Plan Services Paid This Time Only
plain: The patient is in an employer-sponsored prepaid health plan, and services outside that plan are not covered. Because you were not previously notified, the payer is paying this time, but future non-plan services will not be paid.
action: Check plan network and coverage before providing future non-plan services.

title: Claim Separated for Expedited Handling
plain: The claim was split into parts to speed up handling. You will get a separate notice for the other services.
action: No action — await the separate notice for other services.

title: Send Claim to Black Lung
plain: The patient is covered by the Black Lung Program. Send this claim to the Department of Labor, Federal Black Lung Program, at the address provided.
action: Send the claim to the Department of Labor, Federal Black Lung Program.

title: Refund Excess from Other Insurer
plain: This payer is primary and has paid at the primary rate. You must contact the patient's other insurer to refund any excess it paid because it wrongly paid as primary.
action: Contact the patient's other insurer to refund any excess payment.

title: Supplemental insurer copy sent
plain: The claim is also being forwarded to the patient's supplemental insurer for secondary benefits. Questions about those supplemental benefits should go to that insurer.
action: Send supplemental benefit questions to the supplemental insurer.

title: Medigap information invalid
plain: Your Medigap insurer information was incorrect or invalid, so the claim was not forwarded to the Medigap insurer. Verify the Medigap details and submit the secondary claim directly to that insurer.
action: Verify the Medigap insurer information and file the secondary claim directly with the Medigap insurer.

title: SNF catheter-related stay not covered
plain: A skilled nursing facility stay is not covered if the care is mainly for a urethral catheter used for convenience or incontinence control.
action: Review documentation to ensure the SNF stay is not primarily catheter-related, or adjust billing accordingly.

title: SSA name/sex mismatch
plain: Social Security records show a mismatch between the patient's name and sex.
action: Correct the name and sex on the claim and verify against SSA records.

title: Small payment suppressed
plain: A payment of less than $1.00 was suppressed, meaning no payment was issued for this small amount.
action: No action — informational.

title: Demand bill approved
plain: A demand bill was approved after medical review.
action: No action — informational.

title: Christian Science SNF same period
plain: A Christian Science Sanitarium or SNF bill overlaps the same benefit period as another bill.
action: Verify the benefit period and correct overlapping facility claims.

title: Hospice provider change limit
plain: A patient cannot choose a different hospice provider more than once during a benefit period.
action: Verify hospice election records and correct the claim if a prohibited change was billed.

title: Previously informed of rule
plain: This alert indicates the provider was already told about this rule.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing entitlement number/name
plain: The entitlement number or the name shown on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct the entitlement number or name and resubmit the claim.

title: Non-assigned provider notice
plain: This notice is for information only when a physician or supplier did not accept assignment. It does not make them a party to the determination or add appeal rights beyond existing rules.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing invalid type of bill
plain: The type of bill is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct the type of bill and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing billing period dates
plain: The beginning or ending dates for the billed period are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct billing period dates and resubmit.

title: Missing covered days count
plain: The number of covered days in the billing period is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Enter the correct number of covered days and resubmit.

title: Missing non-covered days count
plain: The number of non-covered days in the billing period is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Enter the correct number of non-covered days and resubmit.

title: Missing Coinsurance Days
plain: The claim is missing a valid count of coinsurance days for the billing period, or the count is incomplete.
action: Submit the correct number of coinsurance days for the billing period.

title: Missing Lifetime Reserve Days
plain: The claim is missing a valid number of lifetime reserve days, or the number is incomplete.
action: Submit the correct number of lifetime reserve days.

title: Missing Patient Name
plain: The patient’s name is missing from the claim or is not in a valid format.
action: Provide the patient’s correct name on the claim.

title: Missing Patient Address
plain: The patient’s address is missing from the claim or is not in a valid format.
action: Provide the patient’s complete and correct address.

title: Missing Patient Gender
plain: The patient’s gender is missing from the claim or is not in a valid format.
action: Submit the patient’s correct gender.

title: Missing Admission Date
plain: The admission date is missing from the claim or is not valid.
action: Provide a valid admission date.

title: Missing Admission Type
plain: The admission type is missing from the claim or is not valid.
action: Provide a valid admission type.

title: Missing Admission Source
plain: The admission source is missing from the claim or is not valid.
action: Provide a valid admission source.

title: Missing Patient Status
plain: The patient status is missing from the claim or is not valid.
action: Provide a valid patient status.

title: No Appeal Rights Decision
plain: The payer’s decision was based on law, and you do not have appeal rights for this determination.
action: No action — informational.

title: Payment Held in Special Account
plain: As previously communicated, some or all of the payment is being held in a special account.
action: No action — informational.

title: New Information, No Extra Payment
plain: The payer considered the new information but will not issue any additional payment.
action: No action — informational.

title: Medicare Opt-Out Patient Responsible
plain: Records show you opted out of Medicare and agreed with the patient not to bill Medicare for the furnished services, tests, or supplies. Medicare cannot pay this claim, and the patient is responsible for payment.
action: Do not submit these services to Medicare; bill the patient per the opt-out agreement.

title: Missing Responsible Party or Payer Info
plain: The claim is missing a valid name or address for the responsible party or primary payer, or the information is incomplete.
action: Submit the correct name and address for the responsible party or primary payer.

title: Missing IDE or Clinical Trial Number
plain: The claim is missing a valid Investigational Device Exemption number or Clinical Trial number, or the number is incomplete.
action: Provide a valid IDE number or Clinical Trial number.

title: Missing Competitive Bidding Project ID
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid Competitive Bidding Demonstration Project identifier.
action: Verify and submit the correct Competitive Bidding Demonstration Project ID.

title: Hospice certification or consent late
plain: The physician certification or the patient's election consent for hospice care was not received on time.
action: Obtain and submit the required hospice certification or election consent promptly.

title: Religious non-medical election revoked
plain: The patient received regular medical health care services, which automatically canceled their election for religious non-medical health care. This claim is not covered.
action: Review the patient's election status and do not bill for religious non-medical services.

title: Provider opted out of Medicare
plain: Medicare records show you opted out and agreed not to bill Medicare for these services, so Medicare cannot pay. The patient is responsible, but Federal law limits what you can charge to the limiting charge amount.
action: Do not bill Medicare; collect from the patient within the limiting charge.

title: Patient revoked religious non-medical election
plain: The patient submitted a written request to end their election for religious non-medical health care services.
action: Verify the election status and bill accordingly.

title: Missing release of information indicator
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid release of information indicator.
action: Submit a valid release of information indicator.

title: Patient overpayment refund due
plain: The patient paid you more than the patient responsibility amount shown on this notice. You must refund the difference to the patient within 30 days.
action: Issue the patient a refund within 30 days.

title: Missing patient relationship to insured
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid patient relationship to insured.
action: Submit the correct patient relationship to insured.

title: Missing or invalid SSN
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid Social Security number.
action: Provide a complete and valid Social Security number.

title: Telephone review decision
plain: This decision was made through a telephone review.
action: No action — informational.

title: Invalid principal diagnosis
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid principal diagnosis.
action: Submit a valid principal diagnosis code.

title: Third payer needs prior EOBs
plain: This payer should be the third payer for the claim and cannot process it until it receives payment information from the primary and secondary payers.
action: Submit primary and secondary payer payment information.

title: Invalid admitting diagnosis
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid admitting diagnosis.
action: Submit a valid admitting diagnosis code.

title: Invalid principal procedure code
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has an invalid principal procedure code.
action: Submit a valid principal procedure code.

title: Correction to prior claim
plain: This notice is a correction to an earlier claim.
action: Review the prior claim and correction details.

title: Incomplete Secondary Insurance Crossover Info
plain: The payer did not forward this claim to the secondary insurer because the secondary coverage details supplied were not complete. Give full secondary insurance data or the insurer's PLANID so the claim can be routed correctly.
action: Submit complete secondary insurance information or the correct PLANID.

title: Missing Or Invalid Remarks
plain: The remark field on the claim is absent, incomplete, or unusable. Correct the remark information and resubmit if required.
action: Provide valid, complete remarks on the claim.

title: Missing Provider Representative Signature
plain: The claim is missing the provider representative's signature, or the signature is incomplete or invalid. A valid signature from the provider's representative must be supplied.
action: Obtain and submit the provider representative signature.

title: Missing Provider Representative Signature Date
plain: The date for the provider representative's signature is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Add the correct signature date.
action: Supply a valid provider representative signature date.

title: Patient Overpayment On Assigned Services
plain: For assigned services, the patient's payment exceeds the total patient responsibility plus any amount paid to the patient shown on this notice. The provider must refund the difference to the patient within 30 days.
action: Issue the patient a refund within 30 days.

title: Medicare Demonstration Managed Care Informational
plain: This is an informational remittance for a Medicare demonstration. No fee-for-service Medicare payment is made because the patient chose managed care.
action: No action — informational.

title: Replacement Payment For Prior Claim
plain: This payment takes the place of an earlier claim payment that was lost, damaged, or returned.
action: Apply this as the replacement payment for the affected claim.

title: Missing Patient Or Representative Signature
plain: The patient's signature or an authorized representative's signature is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Obtain the needed signature.
action: Submit a valid patient or authorized representative signature.

title: Missing Home Health Or Hospice ID
plain: For physician care plan oversight, the home health agency or hospice provider identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Supply the correct provider identifier.
action: Provide the correct home health agency or hospice provider identifier.

title: Patient Overpayment Refund Required
plain: The patient overpaid the provider. Refund within 30 days the amount by which the patient's payment, after subtracting Medicare and other payer payments, exceeds the patient responsibility shown on this notice.
action: Issue the patient a refund within 30 days.

title: Billed Above Interim Rate
plain: The billed amount is higher than the interim (temporary) payment rate for this service.
action: Review and correct the billed amount to the interim rate or adjust per payer guidance.

title: Demonstration Hospital Payment Informational Notice
plain: This notice is informational; no payment is issued with it. The hospital was paid by its intermediary for all services in this encounter under a demonstration project.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing Provider Or Supplier Signature
plain: The provider or supplier signature is missing, incomplete, or invalid. A valid signature is needed.
action: Obtain and submit a valid provider or supplier signature.

title: Primary Secondary Payer Status Missing
plain: The claim does not state whether the payer is primary or secondary. Clarify the payer order.
action: Indicate whether the payer is primary or secondary.

title: National Emphysema Trial Eligibility Discrepancy
plain: The patient was identified as being in the National Emphysema Treatment Trial, but records show they are not a participant or not approved for this phase. Contact Johns Hopkins University to resolve any mismatch.
action: Verify trial participation and contact the study coordinator if needed.

title: Missing primary insured address/phone
plain: The primary payer is missing the insured person's address, telephone number, or both, or the information sent is invalid.
action: Obtain and submit the correct primary insured address and telephone number.

title: Missing relationship to primary insured
plain: The claim does not correctly show how the patient is related to the insured person for the primary payer.
action: Provide the correct patient-to-insured relationship code.

title: Missing primary insured employment status
plain: The primary insured's employment status code is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct employment status code for the primary insured.

title: Appeal determination notice
plain: This determination is the outcome of the appeal that was filed.
action: Review the appeal outcome and take any next steps indicated.

title: Missing other insurance plan info
plain: The claim is missing plan information for other insurance that may be involved.
action: Submit the missing other insurance plan details.

title: Claim is non-PIP
plain: This claim is not a Periodic Interim Payment (PIP) claim.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing hospice physician certification
plain: The claim did not include the statement that the attending physician is not a hospice employee.
action: Add the required certification statement if it applies and resubmit.

title: Managed care enrollment mismatch
plain: The claim was rejected because it was submitted as a Medicare Managed Care Demonstration claim, but Medicare's records do not show this patient enrolled in a managed care plan.
action: Confirm the patient's Medicare managed care enrollment, then either correct the enrollment or resubmit without the demonstration coding.

title: Missing managed care or trial number
plain: The Medicare Managed Care Demonstration contract number or clinical trial registry number is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide a valid contract number or clinical trial registry number.

title: Missing Medigap information
plain: Medigap information is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct Medigap information.

title: Missing illness/symptom date
plain: The date of current illness or symptoms is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Enter the correct date of current illness or symptoms.

title: Hemophilia add-on payment
plain: This is a hemophilia add-on payment.
action: No action — informational.

title: Periodic interim payment claim
plain: This claim is a Periodic Interim Payment (PIP) claim.
action: No action — informational.

title: Too many field 19 items
plain: The paper claim has more than three separate data items in field 19.
action: Limit field 19 to no more than three data items and resubmit.

title: Too many field 23 items
plain: The paper claim has more than one data item in field 23.
action: Enter only one data item in field 23 and resubmit.

title: Ambulatory Surgical Guidelines Applied
plain: This claim was processed according to Medicare's ambulatory surgical guidelines.
action: No action — informational.

title: Outside Entity Test Info Missing
plain: The claim is missing or has invalid information about whether diagnostic tests were performed by an outside entity, or whether purchased tests are included.
action: Submit the missing or corrected outside-entity and purchased-test information.

title: Test Purchase Price Or Lab Info Missing
plain: The claim is missing or has invalid information for the test purchase price and/or the performing laboratory's name and address.
action: Provide the test purchase price and the performing laboratory's name and address.

title: Group Practice Information Missing
plain: The claim does not have complete or valid group practice information.
action: Submit correct group practice information and resubmit the claim.

title: Invalid Or Missing TIN
plain: The taxpayer identification number submitted is incomplete or invalid per the IRS, so Medicare cannot process the claim. You may not bill the patient while correcting the TIN, and there are no appeal rights for this unprocessable claim.
action: Notify Medicare of the correct TIN, then resubmit; do not bill the patient during correction.

title: Service Location Information Missing
plain: The claim is missing or has invalid information about where the services were furnished.
action: Submit the missing or corrected service location information.

title: HPSA Service Location Missing
plain: The claim is missing or has invalid physical location details for services rendered in a Health Professional Shortage Area.
action: Provide the required HPSA service location name and address or PIN.

title: Homebound Statement Not Completed
plain: The claim did not complete the 'Homebound' statement needed to confirm whether laboratory services were performed at home or in an institution.
action: Complete the homebound statement and resubmit the claim.

title: One Dollar User Fee Assessed
plain: A $1.00 user fee has been assessed on this claim.
action: No action — informational.

title: VA Veteran Medicare Payment Denied
plain: Medicare issued no payment on this claim for services or supplies a Medicare-eligible veteran received through a Department of Veterans Affairs facility; any applicable coinsurance or deductible still applies.
action: Apply any applicable coinsurance or deductible, but no Medicare payment is issued for the VA-furnished service.

title: CLIA Certification Number Missing
plain: The claim is missing or has an incomplete or invalid CLIA certification number.
action: Submit the correct CLIA certification number and resubmit.

title: X-Ray Date Missing Or Invalid
plain: The x-ray date on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct x-ray date and resubmit.

title: Initial Treatment Date Missing
plain: The initial treatment date on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct initial treatment date and resubmit.

title: Center Not Selected For Study
plain: Because your facility was not chosen to take part in this study, these services are not payable.
action: Do not resubmit for this study unless the center is selected to participate.

title: Payment Constitutes Payment In Full
plain: Under the legislation governing this program, the payment made is considered payment in full.
action: No action — informational.

title: Pancreas Transplant Coverage Limit
plain: A pancreas transplant is not covered by this payer unless the patient also had a kidney transplant.
action: Verify a kidney transplant was performed; if not, remove the pancreas transplant from the claim.

title: Missing FDA Approval Number
plain: The FDA approval number on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct FDA approval number.

title: Unprocessable Claim, No Appeal
plain: The payer could not process this claim at all because some required information is missing or wrong. Since no payment decision could be made, there is nothing to appeal — the remedy is to fix the problems and file it again as a new claim.
action: Correct the missing or invalid information and submit a brand-new claim; do not file an appeal or adjustment.

title: Physician Already Paid Demonstration
plain: The physician has already been paid for services tied to this demonstration claim. The previous claim must be withdrawn and the payment refunded before this claim can be processed.
action: Have the physician withdraw the prior claim and refund the payment.

title: Pre-Demonstration Rate Adjustment
plain: This line adjusts the payment so it reflects the rate that was in effect before the demonstration program began.
action: No action — informational.

title: Claim Overlaps Inpatient Stay
plain: This claim includes services dated during an inpatient hospital stay, and those cannot be billed separately on this claim. Only the services performed before the admission or after the discharge are payable here.
action: Split off the overlapping services and resubmit a claim covering only the care provided outside the inpatient stay.

title: Missing Facility Provider Number
plain: The provider number for the facility where the patient resides is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct provider number for the facility where the patient resides.

title: Appeal Rights Available
plain: You have the right to challenge this decision with a written appeal, but it must be filed within the deadline that starts when you receive this notice. The steps to follow are in your contract or plan documents (or set by state law), and the electronic remittance includes a link to the payer's website with its appeal instructions.
action: If you disagree with the decision, file a written appeal before the deadline using the plan's instructions or the payer website link on the remittance.

title: Most Appropriate Course Allowance
plain: The plan based this payment on its 'most appropriate course of treatment' rule, which lets it pay according to the treatment option it considers most appropriate for the condition rather than the exact service that was billed.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing Consent Form
plain: A consent form is missing.
action: Obtain and submit the missing consent form.

title: Invalid Prior Payer EOB
plain: The prior insurance carrier's EOB is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Obtain and submit a valid prior insurance carrier EOB.

title: Previous Payer EOB Not Filed
plain: An EOB from the previous payer was received, but the claim is not on file with this payer.
action: Submit the claim to this payer.

title: FEHB Medicare Payment Limit
plain: Because this plan is governed by federal employee health benefits (FEHB) law, the most it will pay for covered care is the amount Medicare would have approved — even if the patient is not actually enrolled in Medicare Part A or Part B. The allowed amount was capped at that Medicare-equivalent rate.
action: No action — informational.

title: Major Medical Provision Review
plain: Heads-up: when processing this claim, the payer also evaluated it under the plan's Major Medical benefits, not just the basic benefits. This can affect how much is paid or how the charge counts toward the deductible or out-of-pocket limits.
action: No action — informational alert about how the claim was processed.

title: Crossover Claim Missing Data
plain: This claim was supposed to cross over automatically from the prior payer, but that payer denied it and did not forward the full claim details, so this payer lacks the information needed to make a payment decision.
action: Send a complete claim directly to this payer with all required information instead of relying on the automatic crossover.

title: Prior Payer Estimate Adjustment
plain: This adjustment is an estimate of what a previous payer is expected to pay on the claim. The actual amount that payer pays may differ.
action: Use the estimate when coordinating benefits; confirm with the previous payer.

title: Review-Based Adjustment Determination
plain: This adjustment is based on the findings of a formal review — for example, an independent review organization, professional consult, manual adjudication, medical or dental advisor, or peer review. It reflects that reviewer's determination.
action: Review the determination and appeal if warranted.

title: Medical Review Denial Reversed
plain: A denial was reversed because of medical review. The service may now be payable.
action: No action if payment is correct; reprocess if needed.

title: Medicare Supplemental Enrollment Responsibility
plain: The policy is supplemental to Medicare, but the member does not appear to be enrolled in the applicable Medicare part. The member is responsible for the portion Medicare would have covered.
action: Verify Medicare enrollment and bill the patient for that portion.

title: Professional Technical Component Payment
plain: Payment was based on professional or technical component modifier(s). The modifier split affected the payment.
action: Verify the professional or technical modifiers on the claim.

title: Newborn Services Billed Separately
plain: Newborn services must be billed separately. Do not include them on another claim.
action: Submit a separate claim for newborn services.

title: Out-of-Pocket Maximum Met
plain: The member or family has reached their out-of-pocket maximum, so the plan is now paying a larger share (a higher percentage) of the cost.
action: No action — informational.

title: Incidental Procedure Bundled
plain: This procedure code is incidental to the primary procedure. It is not separately payable.
action: Do not bill separately; review bundling.

title: Same-Date Service Not Payable
plain: This service is not payable with another service rendered on the same date. The two services cannot both be paid together.
action: Review same-date services and bill only the payable service.

title: Line Item Split Alert
plain: Alert: To speed up processing, the payer split one line item on your claim into several lines.
action: No action — informational.

title: Procedure Code Changed Alert
plain: Alert: The payer added or changed a procedure code because the updated code better reflects the service that was actually performed.
action: Review the code change and update records if needed.

title: Patient Liability COB Alert
plain: Alert: What the patient owes could change because another carrier shares responsibility for the bill (coordination of benefits) or because a plan benefit maximum applies.
action: Verify other coverage and plan maximums; inform the patient of possible liability.

title: Missing EFT Banking Information
plain: Electronic funds transfer banking information is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Correct EFT details are needed.
action: Submit corrected EFT banking information.

title: Administrative Claims Payment Only
plain: The company sending this notice only administers claims payments for your benefit plan. It takes on no financial risk or obligation for the claims it processes on the plan's behalf.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing Itemized Bill Statement
plain: An itemized bill or statement is missing. The payer needs it to process the claim.
action: Send the missing itemized bill or statement.

title: Missing Treatment Number
plain: The claim is missing a treatment number, or the number sent is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit the claim with the correct treatment number.

title: Consent Form Requirements Not Met
plain: The required consent form is missing or does not meet the payer’s requirements.
action: Obtain and submit a compliant consent form.

title: Patient Ineligible for Service
plain: The patient was not eligible for this service when it was provided.
action: Verify the patient’s eligibility and benefits, or bill the patient if appropriate.

title: Invalid Prescribing Provider ID
plain: The prescribing provider identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected claim with a valid prescribing provider identifier.

title: Wrong Provider Submitted Claim
plain: This payer only accepts the claim from the provider who personally performed the service, and it was billed by someone else.
action: Have the provider who rendered the service submit the claim under their own name and identifier.

title: No Prior Health Check Record
plain: There is no record of a health check before treatment was started.
action: Submit documentation showing the health check was completed before treatment began.

title: Incorrect Claim Form Format
plain: This service requires a different claim form or format than the one submitted.
action: Rebill the service on the correct claim form or format.

title: Utilization Review Decision
plain: Payment or coverage was decided through a program integrity or utilization review process.
action: Review the decision and follow the payer’s appeal or reconsideration process if needed.

title: Primary Payer Processing Needed
plain: Another insurance plan is primary for this patient. This payer will not consider payment until the primary plan has finished processing the claim under its own rules.
action: Submit the claim to the primary payer first, then send this payer the primary plan’s remittance or explanation of benefits.

title: Missing Tooth Number
plain: The tooth number or letter is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the claim with the correct tooth number or letter.

title: Procedure Tooth Number Mismatch
plain: The billed procedure cannot apply to the tooth identified on the claim — the tooth number or letter does not match the procedure.
action: Correct the procedure code or the tooth number/letter so they agree, then resubmit.

title: Missing Radiology Images
plain: The required radiology film or image was not included with the claim.
action: Send the missing radiology film or image as requested.

title: Missing Mental Health Assessment
plain: The required mental health assessment is missing from the claim.
action: Submit the missing mental health assessment.

title: Bed Hold Days Exceeded
plain: The bed hold or leave days used are more than the allowed number.
action: Review the allowed days and adjust or appeal the claim if appropriate.

title: Payment Based on Authorized Amount
plain: The payment amount was set based on the amount that was authorized.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing or invalid admission hour
plain: The claim's admission hour is missing, incomplete, or not valid. The payer needs the correct hour of admission.
action: Submit a corrected claim with the valid admission hour.

title: Conflict with another inpatient stay
plain: The payer sees this claim as conflicting with another inpatient stay. Check for overlapping or duplicate inpatient claims before resubmitting.
action: Review other inpatient stays and correct, combine, or rebill as appropriate.

title: Mismatch with other insurance carrier
plain: The claim details do not match information the payer got from another insurance carrier. Reconcile the data with the other payer's information.
action: Reconcile with the other carrier's information and resubmit a corrected claim.

title: Validate court-ordered coverage information
plain: This claim involves coverage that was ordered by a court, and the payer has not finished verifying that information. The court order and related coverage details must be confirmed before the claim can be processed.
action: Confirm the court-ordered coverage details with the payer, then resubmit with any needed documentation.

title: Missing or invalid discharge information
plain: The discharge information is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs correct discharge data.
action: Submit a corrected claim with complete discharge information.

title: No electronic interchange agreement on file
plain: There is no electronic interchange agreement on file for the provider or submitter. This agreement is required for electronic claim submission.
action: Complete and file the required electronic interchange agreement.

title: Patient not in managed care plan
plain: On the date of service, the patient was not enrolled in the billing provider's managed care plan. Verify the patient's plan and eligibility.
action: Verify enrollment and bill the correct plan or patient as applicable.

title: Missing or invalid pick-up address
plain: The point-of-pickup address is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs the correct pickup location.
action: Submit a corrected claim with the valid point-of-pickup address.

title: Claim inconsistent with authorized services
plain: The claim does not match the pre-certified or authorized services. Compare the billed services with the authorization.
action: Align the claim with the authorization and resubmit.

title: Provider billing rules not followed
plain: The claim did not follow payer rules for billing group, referring, or performing providers. Correct those provider fields according to payer guidelines.
action: Follow payer billing rules for group, referring, and performing providers.

title: Invalid procedure code for service
plain: The procedure code billed is not valid or correct for the services or date of service. Review the code and date and correct the claim.
action: Correct the procedure code or date and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing or invalid prescribing date
plain: The prescribing date is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs a valid date the prescription was written.
action: Submit a corrected claim with a valid prescribing date.

title: Missing or invalid patient liability
plain: The patient liability amount is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs the correct amount the patient owes.
action: Submit a corrected claim with the correct patient liability amount.

title: See provider manual for details
plain: This is an informational notice rather than a specific billing error. The payer wants you to consult your provider manual, which contains more detail about the program and provider policies behind this claim.
action: Review the provider manual for applicable instructions.

title: Rebill services on separate claims
plain: The payer wants the services billed on separate claims. Split the services and rebill them individually.
action: Split the services and submit separate claims.

title: Services span multiple rate periods
plain: The claim covers dates that fall under more than one payment rate period. Send separate claims for each rate period.
action: Split the services by rate period and resubmit separate claims.

title: Rebill services on separate lines
plain: These services need to be billed on their own claim lines instead of combined. Rebill with each service separated.
action: Rebill each service on its own claim line.

title: From and to dates must differ
plain: The claim's beginning and ending dates cannot be the same. Correct the dates so the from and to dates are different.
action: Correct the service dates and resubmit.

title: Procedure code or rate missing
plain: The payer cannot determine the procedure code or rate count because it is missing or not on file for this date or provider. Check the code and rate information before billing again.
action: Verify the procedure code or rate and resubmit with valid information.

title: Professional services included in facility payment
plain: Professional provider services are not paid separately because they are included in the facility's payment under a demonstration project, so request payment from that facility. You may resubmit the claim only if the facility notifies you the patient was excluded from the demonstration, or if you provided the services at a facility not involved in the demonstration on the same day the patient was admitted to or discharged from a demonstration hospital; in that case, report the non-demonstration facility's provider ID number on the new claim.
action: Contact the demonstration facility for payment. Resubmit only if an exception applies (the patient was excluded from the demonstration, or the services were given at a non-demonstration facility on the admission or discharge date), and include the non-demonstration facility's provider ID on the new claim.

title: Prior payment cancelled for demonstration coverage
plain: A prior payment is being taken back because the patient was later found to be covered by a demonstration project at this place of service. The professional services were part of the facility's payment, so contact the facility for payment and refund any patient or other-insurer payment within 30 days.
action: Refund the patient or other insurer within 30 days and seek payment from the facility.

title: PPS code changed by system
plain: The claims processing system changed the PPS code on this claim. Review the change to make sure it is correct.
action: Review the updated PPS code; no action is needed unless it appears incorrect.

title: Consolidated billing applies
plain: Consolidated billing rules apply, so payment for these services is bundled with the facility's payment. Bill according to the consolidated billing rules instead of separately.
action: Follow consolidated billing rules and do not bill separately.

title: Unassigned claim processed as assigned
plain: Your unassigned claim for a drug, biological, clinical lab, or ambulance service was processed as assigned. Federal law requires you to accept assignment for these service types.
action: Accept assignment for these services as required.

title: PPS code changed by medical review
plain: Medical reviewers changed the PPS code because the clinical records do not support the original code. Review the documentation and use a supported code or appeal if the original code is correct.
action: Review clinical records; correct the PPS code or appeal with supporting documentation.

title: Resubmit with one month per claim
plain: Send multiple claims, with each claim containing only services from a single calendar month. Do not combine services from different months on one claim.
action: Split the services by calendar month and resubmit separate claims.

title: Missing tooth surface information
plain: The claim is missing valid tooth surface information. Add or correct the tooth surface details and resubmit.
action: Provide valid tooth surface information and resubmit.

title: Missing number of riders
plain: The claim is missing a valid number of riders. Enter the correct number of riders and resubmit.
action: Provide the valid number of riders and resubmit.

title: Missing designated provider number
plain: The claim is missing a valid designated provider number. Add or correct the designated provider number and resubmit.
action: Provide the valid designated provider number and resubmit.

title: EPSDT checkup components not completed
plain: The child and teen checkup (EPSDT) did not include all required components. Complete and document the necessary EPSDT components before billing again.
action: Complete and document all required EPSDT components and rebill if appropriate.

title: Service incompatible with patient location
plain: The service billed does not match the patient's location information on the claim. Check the place of service and patient location details, then correct the claim if needed.
action: Verify patient location and place of service, then correct the claim.

title: Missing, incomplete, or invalid prenatal screening info
plain: The prenatal screening information submitted with the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Submit the full, correct prenatal screening details so the claim can be processed.
action: Provide complete, valid prenatal screening information.

title: Procedure incompatible with tooth surface code
plain: The procedure code and the tooth surface code on the claim do not match. Review the dental procedure and surface code, then correct the claim.
action: Correct the procedure or tooth surface code and resubmit.

title: Must accept insurance payment as full
plain: When a third-party payer contract says it pays in full, you must accept that insurance payment as payment in full. Do not bill the patient for additional amounts if the contract requires full reimbursement.
action: Accept the payment as payment in full per contract.

title: No appeal rights for demonstration
plain: There is no right to appeal this decision because it was made under a demonstration project's rules. No action is needed.
action: No action — informational.

title: Further installment payments are forthcoming
plain: The payer will send additional installment payments after this one. No action is needed.
action: No action — informational.

title: Final installment payment
plain: This installment payment is the last one. No further installment payments are expected.
action: No action — informational.

title: Failed pelvic muscle exercise trial required
plain: For biofeedback training to treat urinary incontinence to be covered, the patient must first try pelvic muscle exercise training and that trial must fail. Document the failed trial before billing biofeedback.
action: Document a failed pelvic muscle exercise trial before billing biofeedback.

title: Home biofeedback therapy not covered
plain: Biofeedback therapy used at home is not a covered benefit. Do not bill home biofeedback as covered.
action: Do not bill home biofeedback; check whether another setting is covered.

title: Conditional payment under HHA episode
plain: This payment is conditional because a home health agency (HHA) episode-of-care notice has been filed for this patient. Under consolidated billing, services and supplies like this one must be included in the HHA's payment when the patient is treated under an HHA episode. If the payer confirms the patient is concurrently receiving treatment under an HHA episode, this payment will be recouped from you.
action: Confirm HHA episode status and coordinate with the HHA to avoid duplicate billing or recoupment.

title: Payment forwarded to multiple secondary payers
plain: The claim's payment information was sent to more than one other payer, but this remittance can only list one secondary payer due to format limits. Review other payer remittances or coordination-of-benefits records to identify all secondary payers.
action: Check other payer remittances or COB records; only one secondary payer appears here.

title: Covered only by attending physician
plain: This service is covered only when the attending physician performs it. Verify that the attending physician is the performing provider.
action: Ensure the attending physician performed or performs the service.

title: Services excluded from appeal review
plain: These services were not part of the appeal review, so the appeal decision does not address them. If you expected these services to be reviewed, contact the payer or submit a separate appeal request for them.
action: Contact the payer or file a separate appeal if these services should have been reviewed.

title: Facility not certified for digital mammography
plain: The facility is not certified to perform digital mammography. Verify certification or bill digital mammography at a certified facility.
action: Verify facility certification or use a certified facility.

title: Separate claim per place of service
plain: Each place of service must be billed on its own claim, and services provided at multiple sites cannot be combined on one claim. Submit separate claims by place of service.
action: Submit a separate claim for each place of service.

title: More Specific Taxonomy Needed
plain: The payer needs a more specific taxonomy code before it can process the claim. The code submitted did not identify the provider's specialty precisely enough.
action: Submit a corrected claim with the more specific taxonomy code.

title: Specialty Not Allowed to Bill
plain: The service was billed by a provider whose type or specialty is not authorized to bill it. Payers restrict certain services to particular provider types or specialties, so the claim cannot be paid as submitted.
