action: Confirm whether this provider type or specialty may bill the service; if not, have an eligible provider bill it or adjust/refund as appropriate.

title: Refractory Therapy and Surgical Candidate
plain: The patient must have failed conventional behavioral, drug, and/or surgical treatment and be a suitable candidate for surgery with anesthesia. Coverage depends on documenting both points.
action: Send documentation showing failed conservative treatment and surgical eligibility.

title: Excluded Incontinence or Neurologic Diagnoses
plain: This service excludes patients whose urinary symptoms are secondary to stress incontinence, urinary obstruction, or certain neurologic diseases, such as diabetes with peripheral nerve involvement. These diagnoses do not qualify for coverage.
action: Check whether an excluded diagnosis applies; if so, the service is not covered for that indication.

title: Prior Successful Test Stimulation Required
plain: The patient must have had a successful test stimulation before permanent implantation. The test must show at least 50 percent improvement, as measured by voiding diaries.
action: Provide test stimulation results and voiding diaries showing at least 50% improvement.

title: Voiding Diary Ability Not Shown
plain: The patient must be able to record voiding diary data adequately so the implant results can be evaluated properly. The record must show that this ability is present.
action: Document the patient's ability to keep adequate voiding diary records.

title: Prisoner or Custody Coverage Exclusion
plain: Records show the patient was a prisoner or in the custody of a federal, state, or local authority when the service was provided. This payer does not cover care furnished to someone in custody under a penal statute or rule, except when state or local law makes the patient personally liable for the care and the government actively pursues collecting that debt like its other debts. The provider may seek payment from the responsible custodial authority.
action: Bill the custodial authority responsible for the patient, or resubmit with evidence that the state-law personal-liability exception applies.

title: Wrong Medicare Claims Jurisdiction
plain: This claim is outside the jurisdiction area of the Medicare contractor that received it. Medicare has a different contractor responsible for processing it.
action: Send the claim to the correct Medicare contractor identified on the CMS website.

title: Misdirected RRB Beneficiary Claim
plain: This claim was sent to the wrong payer because the beneficiary is covered through the Railroad Retirement Board. RRB claims follow separate submission instructions.
action: Submit the claim to the RRB carrier, Palmetto GBA, as instructed.

title: SNF Inpatient Payment Goes to Facility
plain: For services provided to a skilled nursing facility inpatient, payment generally can only be made to the SNF, excluding certain excluded services. The provider should seek payment from the SNF instead of the patient.
action: Request payment from the SNF rather than billing the patient.

title: SNF Inpatient Services Must Bundle
plain: Services provided to a skilled nursing facility inpatient must appear on the facility's inpatient claim. Submitting them separately as outpatient services is not permitted.
action: Include the service on the SNF inpatient claim instead of billing it separately.

title: Invalid Upgrade Information
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or has invalid upgrade information. The payer cannot process the upgrade portion without correct details.
action: Send a corrected claim with complete and valid upgrade information.

title: Claim Selected for Complex Review
plain: This claim or service was selected for complex review. The payer will examine it more closely before making a final decision.
action: Respond to any additional documentation request for the complex review.

title: Facility Not Certified for Mammography
plain: Film mammography must be performed at a certified facility. This facility does not hold that certification, so the service cannot be covered.
action: Verify FDA mammography certification or bill through a certified facility.

title: Duplicate Previously Adjudicated Claim
plain: This service was already included in a claim that was billed and processed earlier. There is no appeal right for this denial except when the issue is a duplicate claim or service.
action: Do not appeal unless the issue is a duplicate claim/service; verify the prior adjudication first.

title: Claim Excluded From Electronic Remittance
plain: This claim was left off your electronic remittance advice, so its payment or denial details won't appear on the ERA.
action: Check the paper remittance or payer portal for the claim details.

title: One Initial Visit Covered
plain: A physician, group practice, or provider is paid for only one initial visit per patient; later visits with that provider must be billed as established visits.
action: Confirm whether an initial visit was already paid for this patient by the same physician or group, and if so bill an established-visit code.

title: Ambulance Fee Schedule Transition Payment
plain: During the transition to the ambulance fee schedule, payment is the lower of a blended reasonable charge/cost and fee schedule amount or the submitted charge.
action: Use the yearly blended percentages to verify the payment amount.

title: Local Coverage Determination Applied
plain: The payer based this decision on a Local Coverage Determination (LCD), a policy that spells out when this item or service is covered.
action: Get the LCD from www.cms.gov/mcd or the contractor and confirm the documentation meets its coverage criteria.

title: Conditional Home Health Payment
plain: This home-based service is paid conditionally because the patient may be under a home health episode; if so, the HHA should have billed it and this payment may be recouped.
action: Check whether the patient is under a home health episode and coordinate billing with the HHA.

title: Once Per Lifetime Service
plain: This service is payable only one time over the patient's entire life; any repeat billing will be denied.
action: Check lifetime history before billing this service again.

title: Limited to Once Every 28 Days
plain: The payer won't pay this service if it is billed more often than once every 28 days.
action: Verify the last paid date and bill only after 28 days.

title: 28-Day Rule With Inpatient Stay
plain: Even if billed every 28 days, this service is not paid when the patient had a 5+ consecutive day inpatient or SNF stay in that period.
action: Review inpatient/SNF dates within the 28-day period before billing.

title: Home Health Partial Episode Adjustment
plain: Payment is adjusted under home health PPS because the patient was transferred, discharged, or readmitted during the payment episode.
action: Review the home health episode and the payment adjustment.

title: SNF Stay Practitioner Exclusion
plain: Medicare Part B won't pay for these items or services from this type of practitioner while the beneficiary is in a Part A covered SNF stay.
action: Verify the SNF Part A stay and bill the appropriate payer.

title: Add-On Code Requires Primary
plain: An add-on code must be billed with its primary procedure, not by itself.
action: Add the appropriate primary procedure code and resubmit.

title: Split Service Units
plain: The original service was split, so this line pays only part of the units you billed; the rest are handled separately.
action: Reconcile this line with the original service units.

title: Documentation Lacks Need for Extensive Service
plain: The payer denied or reduced payment because documentation doesn't support the more extensive service; the patient is liable because they were informed in writing and agreed to pay.
action: Confirm the written patient agreement and collect from the patient accordingly.

title: Refund Patient Within 30 Days
plain: Payment was denied or limited because documentation doesn't support the more extensive service, and any patient payment must be refunded within 30 days.
action: Refund any patient payment within 30 days and follow Medicare refund rules.

title: Deported Beneficiary Not Covered
plain: Social Security records show the patient was deported, and this payer doesn't cover services furnished to deported individuals.
action: Verify eligibility; services to deported individuals are not covered.

title: Misdirected UMWA claim
plain: This claim or service belongs to a United Mine Workers of America beneficiary and was sent to the wrong payer. Submit it to UMWA.
action: Submit the claim or service to UMWA.

title: Pre-coverage allowance portion
plain: This amount is the part of the allowed charge that applies before coverage starts.
action: No action — informational.

title: Age eligibility denial
plain: The patient is not eligible for this service because of their age.
action: Verify the patient's age against the plan's age-based eligibility rules; correct and resubmit if the claim was billed in error.

title: Check plan service restrictions
plain: The plan's benefit documents or guidelines contain information about restrictions for this service. Review them.
action: Review plan benefit documents or guidelines for restrictions.

title: Multiple contract payment cap
plain: Total payments from multiple contracts cannot be more than the allowed amount for this service.
action: Ensure combined contract payments do not exceed the allowance.

title: Debarred provider payment stop
plain: After a 30-day grace period, payments will stop for services from a provider debarred or excluded by the US Government.
action: Resolve exclusion or stop billing this payer for excluded provider services.

title: Predetermination and payment separate
plain: Predetermination requests and payment requests for services are handled separately.
action: Track and submit predetermination and payment requests separately.

title: Scheduled payment notice
plain: This is the scheduled payment for the service. If treatment was discontinued, contact Customer Service.
action: Contact Customer Service if treatment was discontinued.

title: Record fees patient responsibility
plain: The patient must pay record fees, but this is limited to the specified copayment.
action: Bill patient for record fees up to the specified copayment.

title: Arizona appeal information
plain: To learn how to file an appeal in Arizona, call the Department's Consumer Assistance Office at the listed numbers.
action: Call the Department's Consumer Assistance Office at (602) 912-8444 or (800) 325-2548 for the Arizona appeal process.

title: Provider appeal complaint rights
plain: A provider acting for the member can appeal to the payer. If urgent care has not been given, the provider can also complain to the State Insurance Regulatory Authority without appealing first.
action: Obtain the regulator's address and follow the appeal or complaint path.

title: Second dental advisor review
plain: If you disagree with the Dental Advisor and have more case information, you can send radiographs for a second independent review.
action: Send radiographs and any additional case information to the Dental Advisor Unit at the subscriber's dental insurance carrier for a second review.

title: Non-participating dental appeal rule
plain: A non-participating provider cannot appeal on their own. If the beneficiary appoints them in writing as representative, they can appeal with required documents within 90 days.
action: If appointed in writing, submit the letter, disagreement statement, radiographs, and relevant info within 90 days.

title: OCONUS dental appeal rule
plain: You are not an authorized OCONUS provider, so you cannot appeal on your own. If the beneficiary appoints you in writing, you can appeal with required documents within 90 days.
action: If appointed in writing, submit the letter, disagreement statement, and relevant info within 90 days.

title: Long-term care residency mismatch
plain: The patient was not in a long-term care facility for all or part of the billed service dates.
action: Verify facility residency dates and correct the claim if needed.

title: Resubmit as New Claim
plain: The first claim was denied, so the payer needs a completely new submission rather than a corrected or replacement version of that claim.
action: Submit a new claim rather than a replacement claim.

title: Hospice Status Not Met
plain: The patient was not in a hospice program for at least part of the dates billed. This affects coverage for those hospice-related services.
action: Verify hospice status and service dates, then correct or resubmit the claim.

title: Rate Changed During Service
plain: The payment rate changed during the dates of service on the claim. The claim may need adjustment to reflect the correct rate for each date.
action: Review the rate change and rebill using the correct rate for each date.

title: Missing Screening Document
plain: A required screening document was not included. The claim cannot be processed correctly without it.
action: Send the missing screening document.

title: Missing Patient ID for LTC Rate
plain: The long-term care case mix or per diem rate cannot be determined because the patient ID number on the assignment request is missing, incomplete, or invalid. A valid ID is needed to price the claim.
action: Correct or complete the patient ID on the assignment request.

title: Missing Last Menstrual Period Date
plain: The date of the patient's last menstrual period is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The claim needs a complete and accurate date.
action: Provide a complete and valid date of last menstrual period.

title: Rebill Services on One Claim
plain: All applicable services should be billed together on a single claim instead of separate claims. Rebill them on one claim.
action: Rebill all applicable services together on one claim.

title: Missing Model Number
plain: A required model number is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The claim needs a complete and valid model number to be processed.
action: Provide the missing or corrected model number.

title: Face-to-Face Requirement Not Met
plain: Telephone contact services will not be paid until the required face-to-face contact has occurred. The payer will not pay those services before that requirement is met.
action: Meet the face-to-face contact requirement before billing telephone contact services.

title: Missing Replacement Claim Information
plain: The replacement claim information is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs complete replacement claim details to process it.
action: Provide complete replacement claim information.

title: Missing Room and Board Rate
plain: The room and board rate is missing, incomplete, or invalid. A complete and valid rate is needed to process this part of the claim.
action: Provide a valid room and board rate.

title: Provider Mailing Address Correction
plain: This payment was delayed so the provider's mailing address could be corrected. Check that the payer has the right mailing address.
action: Verify and correct the provider mailing address.

title: Other Insurance Not on File
plain: The payer's records do not show other insurance on file. They are asking for other insurance information to update their records.
action: Submit other insurance information for the payer's records.

title: Patient Responsible for Elective Difference
plain: The patient owes the difference in cost between the treatment the plan approved and the elective treatment that was chosen. The elective portion is the patient's responsibility.
action: Inform the patient of the difference and bill only as allowed.

title: Transportation Destination Not Covered
plain: Transportation to or from the destination on the claim is not covered. The payer will not pay for that transportation.
action: Do not bill for transportation to or from that destination.

title: Non-ambulance transport not covered
plain: Transportation in a vehicle that is not an ambulance is not covered. The payer will not pay for this type of transport.
action: Verify the transport type and bill only covered ambulance transport.

title: Mileage without patient in ambulance
plain: Mileage is not covered when the patient is not in the ambulance, so payment was denied or reduced. The payer will not pay for mileage in that situation.
action: Review the mileage charge and remove it if the patient was not in the ambulance.

title: Patient option needed before payment
plain: The patient must choose an option before the payer can pay for this procedure, equipment, supply, or service. Payment is held until that choice is made.
action: Obtain the patient's required option selection before resubmitting.

title: Dependent coverage with associated service
plain: This drug, service, or supply is covered only if the associated service is also covered. If the associated service is denied, this item will also be denied.
action: Verify the associated service is covered and correct or appeal if it was denied.

title: Lab certification mismatch alert
plain: This claim was paid, but the test or specialty billed is not included in your laboratory certification. If you do not correct the certification information, future payments will be denied.
action: Correct laboratory certification information with the payer immediately to avoid future denials.

title: Medical record doesn't support code
plain: The documentation in the medical record does not support the code that was billed, based on that code's definition.
action: Review the documentation and either correct the code or submit records that support the billed code.

title: Post-transplant coverage limit exceeded
plain: The charges are more than the coverage limit that applies after a transplant. The payer will not pay the amount above that limit.
action: Review the post-transplant limit and adjust the charge or bill the patient only if allowed.

title: Certificate of medical necessity needed
plain: A new, revised, or renewed certificate of medical necessity is required. Payment cannot be made until the proper certificate is received.
action: Obtain and submit the required certificate of medical necessity.

title: Repair/replacement not covered or capped
plain: Payment for this repair or replacement is not covered, or the charge has exceeded the original purchase price. The payer denied or reduced payment for that reason.
action: Check the purchase price and coverage rules, and adjust the charge if needed.

title: Patient not liable for updated item
plain: The patient is not responsible for the denied or adjusted charges for receiving an updated service or item. The provider cannot bill the patient for those amounts.
action: Do not bill the patient for the denied or adjusted amount.

title: Missing qualifying hospital stay dates
plain: The claim did not include the hospital stay dates that qualify this episode of care. The payer needs those dates to determine coverage.
action: Submit the qualifying hospital stay dates for this episode of care.

title: Non-covered but patient liability limited
plain: This service, procedure, equipment, or bed is not covered, but the patient's responsibility is limited to the amounts shown under the PR adjustment group. Do not bill the patient more than those amounts.
action: Bill the patient only the PR adjustment amounts and write off the rest.

title: Missing review organization approval
plain: The claim is missing approval from the required review organization. Payment cannot be made until that approval is obtained.
action: Obtain the review organization approval and resubmit the claim.

title: Shipboard services coverage rules
plain: Services provided on a ship are covered only when the ship is US-registered and in US waters, and the doctor must be licensed in the US. If any condition is not met, the service is not covered.
action: Verify all shipboard coverage conditions and submit documentation if they are met.

title: Claim not sent to other insurer
plain: The payer did not send this claim to the patient's other insurer, and that insurer has indicated no additional payment can be made. No further payment is expected from the other insurer.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing Pre-Op Images or Visual Fields
plain: Pre-operative images or visual field results are missing. The claim may need those records before it can be processed.
action: Submit the missing pre-operative images or visual field results.

title: Member Information Requested for Reconsideration
plain: The payer needs more information from the member. The charges will be reviewed again after that information is received.
action: Help obtain the requested member information and send it to the payer.

title: Service Does Not Match Billed Category
plain: This item or service does not fit the category used on the claim. Check whether it was billed under the wrong category.
action: Review the category and rebill under the correct category if appropriate.

title: Other Provider Information Required
plain: The payer needs more information from another provider involved in this service. The claim cannot be finalized until that information is received.
action: Coordinate with the other provider to supply the requested information.

title: Bill According to Plan Schedule
plain: This claim or service must follow this plan's billing schedule. Review the plan's schedule and bill it that way.
action: Rebill the service according to the plan's required schedule.

title: Predetermination Documentation Required Later
plain: This is an advance notice for a predetermination. If the service is submitted for payment, plan documents will require additional documentation.
action: Note the documentation requirements and submit them with any future payment claim.

title: Rebill Technical and Professional Separately
plain: The technical and professional parts of this service must be billed on separate claims. Split the components and resubmit.
action: Submit the technical component and the professional component as separate billings.

title: Do Not Resubmit This Claim
plain: The payer says this claim or service should not be resubmitted. Follow the notice's instructions instead of sending it again.
action: Stop resubmission attempts for this claim; handle it only as the notice directs.

title: Non-Availability Statement Required
plain: This service requires a Non-Availability Statement (NAS) — documentation from a military facility that the needed care was not available there. The nearest Military Treatment Facility (MTF) can help.
action: Work with the nearest Military Treatment Facility to get the required NAS.

title: Written Review May Be Requested
plain: A written review may be requested within the plan's time limits. The contract or plan benefit documents explain how to ask for it.
action: Follow the contract or plan instructions to request a written review if desired.

title: Approved Care Level Mismatch
plain: The level of care approved by the plan does not match the procedure code on the claim. Review the approval and the code submitted.
action: Correct the procedure code or seek review if the approved level of care is correct.

title: One-Time Exception Payment
plain: This service was paid as a one-time exception to the plan's benefit limits. It does not mean the service is normally covered.
action: No action for this claim; treat coverage as a one-time exception.

title: Missing Contract Indicator
plain: The claim is missing a contract indicator. The payer needs that indicator to process the claim correctly.
action: Add the missing contract indicator and resubmit the claim.

title: Update Insurance Information With Payer
plain: The patient's insurance information must be updated by the provider working directly with the payer. The change cannot be made just by submitting this claim.
action: Contact the payer directly to update the patient's insurance information on file.

title: Patient Is Medicaid or QMB
plain: The patient is a Medicaid beneficiary or a Qualified Medicare Beneficiary. Check the patient's status and follow the plan's billing rules for that coverage.
action: Verify Medicaid/QMB status and apply the correct billing rules.

title: Other program may cover service
plain: A federal, state, or local program might cover this service through a different payer. Check whether the patient is enrolled in such a program and route the claim to the correct payer if needed.
action: Verify other program coverage and bill the appropriate payer.

title: Technical component ownership rule
plain: The technical component will not be paid unless the provider owns the equipment used for the service. Confirm equipment ownership before billing that component.
action: Confirm the provider owns the equipment; if not, do not bill the technical component to this payer.

title: Bill technical component separately
plain: The technical component must be billed on its own. Do not combine it with other components on the same claim.
action: Submit the technical component on a separate claim or line as required.

title: Patient may qualify for other coverage
plain: The patient may be eligible to apply for another insurance plan that could be primary. Check for that coverage and update coordination of benefits.
action: Tell the patient to apply for other coverage and update primary insurance information.

title: Subscriber must update insurance
plain: The subscriber needs to give updated insurance information directly to the payer. The provider cannot make this change for the subscriber.
action: Instruct the subscriber to update insurance information directly with the payer.

title: Rendering provider affiliation required
plain: The rendering provider needs an established affiliation with the pay-to provider for this claim to be processed. Verify and correct the affiliation before resubmitting.
action: Ensure the rendering provider is affiliated with the pay-to provider, then resubmit.

title: Payer audit payment adjustment
plain: A payer-initiated review or audit approved an additional payment or recoupment. Apply the approved adjustment to the account.
action: Post the additional payment or recoupment as approved; no further action unless disputing.

title: Bill professional component separately
plain: The professional component must be billed on its own. Do not combine it with the technical component on the same claim.
action: Submit the professional component on a separate claim or line as required.

title: Additional explanation to follow
plain: The payer will send additional information or explanation separately from this remittance. No immediate action is required from the provider.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing or invalid anesthesia time
plain: The anesthesia time or units on the claim are missing, incomplete, or invalid. Provide complete and valid anesthesia time and units.
action: Submit a corrected claim with valid anesthesia time and units.

title: Pre-existing condition review requested
plain: The payer is reviewing this service for a possible pre-existing condition. Send the requested medical records from the prior 12 months.
action: Send medical records covering the prior 12 months.

title: Illegible information submitted
plain: The information provided to the payer could not be read. Send a legible copy or corrected claim.
action: Resubmit legible information or a corrected claim.

title: Documentation does not match claim
plain: The documents submitted to support this claim do not match what was reported on the claim itself. Review both and correct the discrepancy.
action: Reconcile the documentation with the claim and submit corrected information.

title: Missing or invalid weight
plain: The patient's weight is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Provide the correct weight on a corrected claim.
action: Submit the patient's correct weight.

title: Missing or invalid DRG code
plain: The DRG code is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Provide a valid DRG code on a corrected claim.
action: Submit a valid DRG code.

title: Missing or Invalid TIN
plain: The taxpayer identification number on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs the correct TIN to process the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct TIN on the claim.

title: Decision May Be Appealed
plain: This remark tells you that the payer's decision on this claim or service can be appealed. Review the payer's appeal instructions and deadlines.
action: Review and file an appeal within the payer's deadline if appropriate.

title: Decision May Not Be Appealed
plain: This remark tells you that the payer's decision on this claim or service cannot be appealed. Other correction or rebilling options may still apply if allowed.
action: Do not file an appeal for this decision.

title: Processed Under Point-of-Service Benefit
plain: The charges were processed under a point-of-service benefit. This may affect cost-sharing or benefit rules for the claim.
action: Check the patient's point-of-service benefit and cost-sharing.

title: Missing Facility DRG Exempt Status
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid information about facility or discrete unit DRG status or DRG exempt status. The payer needs this information to process the claim.
action: Submit the correct facility or discrete unit DRG or DRG exempt status information.

title: Missing Related Initial Surgery History
plain: The claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid history for the related initial surgical procedure or procedures. The payer needs this history to process the claim.
action: Provide the history of the related initial surgical procedure or procedures.

title: Secondary Payer Cannot Require Primary Determination
plain: A supplemental or secondary payer may not require the primary payer's claim determination for this service as a condition of making its own determination. The secondary payer must process the claim without first waiting for the primary payer's decision.
action: If the secondary payer delays or denies the claim for lack of a primary determination, cite this remark and request processing.

title: Service Not Covered or Not Enrolled
plain: The payer does not cover this type of service, or the patient is not enrolled in this portion of the benefit package. The claim is not payable under this benefit.
action: Verify benefit coverage and inform the patient of the non-covered status.

title: One Site of Service Payment
plain: The payer allows payment for only one site of service per provider on a claim. Additional sites of service may require separate claims.
action: Submit separate claims for additional sites of service if appropriate.

title: Furnish and Service Item Requirement
plain: You must keep furnishing and servicing this item for as long as the patient continues to need it. The payer may cover maintenance or servicing only for the period stated in the contract or coverage manual.
action: Follow the contract or coverage manual and provide the required servicing.

title: Payment Based on Previous Allowed Amount
plain: The payment was calculated using the allowed amount from the previous payer. This is a coordination-of-benefits pricing method.
action: Confirm the previous payer's allowed amount if needed; no action if correct.

title: Provider Dispute Forms and Instructions
plain: The payer directs you to its website or customer service department to get forms and instructions for filing a provider dispute. Use those resources to start the dispute process.
action: Obtain the dispute forms and instructions from the payer's website or customer service.

title: Missing Admitting History and Physical
plain: The admitting history and physical report is missing from the claim or supporting documentation. The payer needs this report to process the claim.
action: Submit the admitting history and physical report.

title: Invalid Admitting History and Physical
plain: The admitting history and physical report is incomplete or invalid. The payer needs a complete and valid report to process the claim.
action: Submit a complete and valid admitting history and physical report.

title: Missing Initial Treatment Benefit Documentation
plain: Documentation is missing that shows the patient benefited from the service during the initial treatment period. The payer needs this documentation to support the claim.
action: Submit documentation showing benefit to the patient during the initial treatment period.

title: Missing Initial Treatment Benefit Documentation
plain: The documentation showing that the patient actually benefited (made clinical progress) from treatment during the initial treatment period is incomplete or invalid. This refers to the patient's clinical improvement, not insurance benefits.
action: Submit complete documentation of the patient's clinical benefit during the initial treatment period.

title: Invalid ADA Recognition Certificate
plain: A current American Diabetes Association Certificate of Recognition is required, but the one submitted is missing or invalid.
action: Obtain and submit a valid ADA Certificate of Recognition.

title: Invalid Medical Necessity Certificate
plain: The Certificate of Medical Necessity is incomplete or not valid, so it cannot support the claim.
action: Complete or correct the Certificate of Medical Necessity and resubmit.

title: Invalid Consent Form
plain: The required consent form is either missing information or not valid.
action: Submit a complete, valid consent form.

title: Invalid Contract Indicator
plain: The contract indicator on the claim or documentation is missing or invalid.
action: Provide the correct contract indicator with the claim or documentation.

title: Missing Equipment Ownership Indicator
plain: The payer needs to know whether the patient owns the equipment that uses the billed part or supply, and that information is missing or invalid.
action: Submit a clear statement of whether the patient owns the equipment.

title: Invalid Intraocular Lens Invoice
plain: The lens invoice or statement is incomplete or invalid; it must show the actual lens cost after discounts and/or the intraocular lens type.
action: Send a corrected invoice or statement for the lens cost and type.

title: Invalid Itemized Bill
plain: The payer requires an itemized bill or statement that lists each charge separately, and the one submitted is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete itemized bill or statement listing each charge.

title: Invalid Operative Note
plain: The operative note or report describing what was done during the procedure is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit the complete operative note or report.

title: Invalid Oxygen Certification
plain: The certification or recertification documenting the patient's medical need for oxygen therapy is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit completed oxygen certification or recertification.

title: Invalid Pacemaker Registration Form
plain: The form used to register the patient's pacemaker is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid pacemaker registration form.

title: Invalid Pathology Report
plain: The pathology report needed to support this service is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit the complete pathology report.

title: Invalid Patient Medical Record
plain: The patient's medical record for this specific service is incomplete or invalid, so the payer cannot verify the care that was provided.
action: Submit the complete patient medical record for this service.

title: Invalid Certified Plan of Care
plain: The plan of care that the physician must certify (formally approve and sign) is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected physician-certified plan of care.

title: Invalid Physician Financial Relationship Form
plain: The form disclosing the physician's financial relationship is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a completed, valid physician financial relationship form.

title: Radiology report missing or invalid
plain: The radiology report needed for this claim is missing, incomplete, or not valid.
action: Submit a complete and valid radiology report.

title: Review organization approval issue
plain: Approval from the utilization review organization for this service is incomplete or was not accepted as valid.
action: Contact the review organization to complete or correct the approval, then resubmit the claim with the valid approval.

title: Radiology images missing or invalid
plain: The required radiology films or images are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid radiology films or images.

title: Screening document incomplete or unapproved
plain: A required screening document was rejected because it was incomplete, invalid, or had not been approved.
action: Obtain the necessary approval and submit a complete, valid version of the screening document.

title: Pre-op images or visual fields
plain: The claim does not include complete, valid pre-operative imaging or visual field test results.
action: Obtain complete pre-operative images or visual field results and submit them with the claim.

title: Other insurance plan information
plain: The information about the patient's other insurance plan is incomplete or invalid.
action: Obtain and submit complete other insurance plan information.

title: State patient payment limits
plain: State law limits the amount the patient can be required to pay for this service.
action: Check the state-regulated patient payment limit and adjust the patient's responsibility so it does not exceed that limit.

title: Assistant surgeon taxonomy
plain: The assistant surgeon's taxonomy code, which identifies their specialty, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the assistant surgeon's taxonomy code and resubmit the claim.

title: Assistant surgeon name
plain: The claim does not show a complete and correct name for the assistant surgeon.
action: Enter the assistant surgeon's full, correct name and resubmit the claim.

title: Assistant surgeon primary ID
plain: The assistant surgeon's primary identifier — usually the NPI — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify the assistant surgeon's NPI and resubmit the claim with the correct identifier.

title: Assistant surgeon secondary ID
plain: The assistant surgeon's secondary identifier, such as a state license or payer-assigned number, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify the assistant surgeon's secondary identifier and resubmit with the correct value.

title: Attending provider taxonomy
plain: The attending provider's taxonomy code, which identifies their specialty, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the attending provider's taxonomy code and resubmit the claim.

title: Attending provider name
plain: The claim does not show a complete and correct name for the attending provider.
action: Enter the attending provider's full, correct name and resubmit the claim.

title: Attending provider primary ID
plain: The attending provider's primary identifier — usually the NPI — is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify the attending provider's NPI and resubmit the claim with the correct identifier.

title: Attending provider secondary ID
plain: The attending provider's secondary identifier, such as a state license or payer-assigned number, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify the attending provider's secondary identifier and resubmit with the correct value.

title: Billing provider taxonomy missing
plain: The taxonomy code for the billing provider is absent, incomplete, or not valid. This code identifies the provider's specialty type, so the payer cannot process the claim without it.
action: Verify the billing provider's taxonomy code and submit a corrected claim.

title: Billing provider name problem
plain: The billing provider's name is missing, partial, or not in a form the payer accepts. The payer needs the full name as enrolled to match the claim to the right provider record.
action: Correct the billing provider name to match enrollment records and resubmit the claim.

title: Billing provider ID invalid
plain: The primary identifier for the billing provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This is usually the provider's NPI, which links the claim to the correct enrolled provider; payer-assigned numbers are reported as secondary identifiers instead.
action: Confirm the billing provider's NPI or other primary identifier and refile with the correct value.

title: Billing provider address problem
plain: The billing provider's address is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer uses this address to confirm the provider's location on file.
action: Update the billing provider address so it matches what the payer has on file, then resubmit.

title: Billing provider secondary ID invalid
plain: The billing provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Secondary IDs are payer-specific numbers used alongside the primary identifier.
action: Verify the correct secondary identifier for this payer and correct the claim.

title: Billing provider contact info problem
plain: The billing provider's contact information is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer may need this to reach the provider about the claim.
action: Add or correct the billing provider's contact details and resubmit the claim.

title: Operating provider name problem
plain: The name of the operating provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The operating provider is the clinician who performed the surgery or procedure, reported mainly on institutional claims — this is a different role from the rendering provider on professional claims.
action: Enter the operating provider's correct name as it appears in enrollment records and refile.

title: Operating provider ID invalid
plain: The primary identifier for the operating provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer cannot tie the procedure to a specific performing provider.
action: Supply the operating provider's valid primary identifier and resubmit the claim.

title: Operating provider secondary ID invalid
plain: The operating provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This is a payer-specific number used in addition to the primary ID.
action: Confirm the operating provider's secondary identifier with the payer and correct the claim.

title: Ordering provider name problem
plain: The name of the provider who ordered the service or item is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Ordering provider details are often required for labs, imaging, and DME.
action: Add the ordering provider's correct name and refile the claim.

title: Ordering provider ID invalid
plain: The primary identifier for the ordering provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Without it the payer cannot verify who ordered the service.
action: Enter the ordering provider's valid primary identifier and resubmit.

title: Ordering provider address problem
plain: The ordering provider's address is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer may use it to confirm the identity and enrollment of the provider who ordered the service.
action: Correct the ordering provider's address on the claim and send it again.

title: Ordering provider secondary ID invalid
plain: The ordering provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This is a payer-assigned number that accompanies the primary identifier.
action: Check the ordering provider's secondary identifier with the payer and refile.

title: Ordering provider contact info problem
plain: The ordering provider's contact information is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer may need it to reach the ordering provider with questions.
action: Supply accurate contact information for the ordering provider and resubmit the claim.

title: Other provider name problem
plain: The name of another provider listed on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This covers provider roles other than billing, operating, or ordering.
action: Identify the provider role that is affected, correct the name, and refile the claim.

title: Other Provider Primary ID Missing
plain: The primary identifier for the "other" provider listed on the claim is absent, incomplete, or not a valid value. This identifier is usually the other provider's NPI.
action: Add or correct the other provider's primary identifier (typically the NPI) and resubmit the claim.

title: Other Provider Secondary ID Missing
plain: The secondary identifier for the "other" provider is missing, cut short, or invalid. Secondary identifiers are things like a state license number or a payer-assigned ID rather than the NPI.
action: Supply or fix the other provider's secondary identifier and resubmit the claim.

title: Other Payer Attending Provider ID Missing
plain: For a claim that involves another payer, the identifier for the attending provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This field is typically required when the other payer is primary and its adjudication data is reported.
action: Enter the correct attending provider identifier for the other payer and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Operating Provider ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the operating provider as required by the other payer is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Operating provider refers to the individual who performed the procedure.
action: Add or correct the other payer's operating provider identifier and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Other Provider ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the "other" provider category on the other payer's portion of the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This is the catch-all slot for providers that do not fit the named roles.
action: Supply the correct other provider identifier for the other payer and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Purchased Service ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the provider who furnished a purchased service, as required by the other payer, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the other payer's purchased service provider identifier and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Referring Provider ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the provider who referred the patient, as required by the other payer, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Enter the correct referring provider identifier for the other payer and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Rendering Provider ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the provider who actually rendered the service, as required by the other payer, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the other payer's rendering provider identifier and resubmit.

title: Other Payer Service Facility ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the facility where the service took place, as required by the other payer, is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Supply the correct other payer service facility identifier and resubmit.

title: Pay-To Provider Name Missing
plain: The name of the provider or entity that should receive payment is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The pay-to name must be reported when it differs from the billing provider.
action: Add or correct the pay-to provider name and resubmit the claim.

title: Pay-To Provider Primary ID Missing
plain: The primary identifier for the pay-to provider (usually the NPI) is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the pay-to provider's primary identifier and resubmit.

title: Pay-To Provider Address Missing
plain: The address for the pay-to provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Payer payment is directed using this address.
action: Correct the pay-to provider address and resubmit the claim.

title: Pay-To Provider Secondary ID Missing
plain: The secondary identifier for the pay-to provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This is an identifier other than the NPI, such as a payer-assigned number.
action: Add or correct the pay-to provider's secondary identifier and resubmit.

title: Purchased Service Provider ID Missing
plain: The identifier for the provider who furnished a purchased service on this claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Required when services are bought from another provider.
action: Add or correct the purchased service provider identifier and resubmit.

title: Referring Provider Taxonomy Missing
plain: The taxonomy code for the referring provider is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Taxonomy codes identify a provider's specialty.
action: Add or correct the referring provider's taxonomy code and resubmit.

title: Referring Provider Name Missing
plain: The referring provider's name is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct referring provider name on the claim.

title: Referring Provider Primary ID Missing
plain: The referring provider's primary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct referring provider primary identifier on the claim.

title: Referring Provider Secondary ID Missing
plain: The referring provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct referring provider secondary identifier on the claim.

title: Rendering Provider Taxonomy Missing
plain: The rendering provider's taxonomy code is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct rendering provider taxonomy on the claim.

title: Rendering Provider Name Missing
plain: The rendering provider's name is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct rendering provider name on the claim.

title: Rendering Provider Primary ID Missing
plain: The rendering provider's primary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct rendering provider primary identifier on the claim.

title: Rendering Provider Secondary ID Missing
plain: The rendering provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct rendering provider secondary identifier on the claim.

title: Service Facility Name Missing
plain: The service facility's name is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct service facility name on the claim.

title: Service Facility Primary ID Missing
plain: The service facility's primary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct service facility primary identifier on the claim.

title: Service Facility Primary Address Missing
plain: The service facility's primary address is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct service facility primary address on the claim.

title: Service Facility Secondary ID Missing
plain: The service facility's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct service facility secondary identifier on the claim.

title: Supervising Provider Name Missing
plain: The supervising provider's name is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct supervising provider name on the claim.

title: Supervising Provider Primary ID Missing
plain: The supervising provider's primary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct supervising provider primary identifier on the claim.

title: Supervising Provider Secondary ID Missing
plain: The supervising provider's secondary identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Verify and submit the correct supervising provider secondary identifier on the claim.

title: Occurrence Date(s) Missing
plain: The occurrence date or dates are missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Verify and submit the correct occurrence date(s) on the claim.

title: Missing or Invalid Occurrence Span Date
plain: The occurrence span date on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and supply the correct occurrence span date.

title: Missing or Invalid Procedure Date
plain: The procedure date on the claim is absent, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the procedure date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Other Procedure Date
plain: An other procedure date on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and provide the correct other procedure date.

title: Missing or Invalid Principal Procedure Date
plain: The principal procedure date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the principal procedure date on the claim.

title: Missing or Invalid Dispensed Date
plain: The dispensed date is missing, incomplete, or invalid on the claim.
action: Supply the correct dispensed date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Injury/Accident Date
plain: The injury or accident date is absent, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and provide the correct injury or accident date.

title: Missing or Invalid Acute Manifestation Date
plain: The acute manifestation date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the acute manifestation date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Adjudication/Payment Date
plain: The adjudication or payment date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and supply the correct adjudication or payment date.

title: Missing or Invalid Appliance Placement Date
plain: The appliance placement date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the appliance placement date on the claim.

title: Missing or Invalid Assessment Date
plain: The assessment date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct assessment date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Assumed/Relinquished Care Date
plain: The assumed or relinquished care date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and supply the correct assumed or relinquished care date.

title: Missing or Invalid Return-to-Work Date
plain: The authorized return-to-work date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct or add the return-to-work date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Begin Therapy Date
plain: The begin therapy date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and provide the correct begin therapy date.

title: Missing or Invalid Certification Revision Date
plain: The certification revision date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Supply the correct certification revision date and resubmit as needed.

title: Missing or Invalid Diagnosis Date
plain: The diagnosis date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Review the claim and provide the correct diagnosis date.

title: Missing Disability From Date
plain: The disability start date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct disability from date.

title: Missing Disability To Date
plain: The disability end date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct disability to date.

title: Missing Discharge Hour
plain: The discharge hour is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct discharge hour.

title: Missing Discharge or End of Care Date
plain: The discharge or end of care date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct discharge or end of care date.

title: Missing Hearing/Vision Prescription Date
plain: The date of the hearing or vision prescription is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct hearing or vision prescription date.

title: Missing Home Health Certification Period
plain: The home health certification period is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct home health certification period.

title: Missing Last Admission Period
plain: The last admission period is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct last admission period.

title: Missing Last Certification Date
plain: The last certification date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct last certification date.

title: Missing Last Contact Date
plain: The last contact date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct last contact date.

title: Missing Last Seen/Visit Date
plain: The last seen or visit date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct last seen or visit date.

title: Missing Last Worked Date
plain: The last worked date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct last worked date.

title: Missing Last X-Ray Date
plain: The last x-ray date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct last x-ray date.

title: Missing Other Insured Birth Date
plain: The birth date of the other insured person is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct other insured birth date.

title: Missing Oxygen Saturation Test Date
plain: The date of the oxygen saturation test is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide the correct oxygen saturation test date.

title: Missing Patient Birth Date
plain: The patient's birth date is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct patient birth date.

title: Patient Death Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date of the patient's death is either absent from the claim or was submitted in a form the payer cannot read. This date is often needed for Medicare and other coverage determinations.
action: Verify the date of death and resubmit the claim with a complete, valid date.

title: Physician Order Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The claim does not show a usable date for the physician's order that authorized the service or item. The payer needs that order date to confirm the service was properly ordered before it was provided.
action: Obtain the signed order date from the physician and resubmit with the correct date.

title: Prior Hospital Discharge Date Missing
plain: The date the patient was discharged from a prior hospital stay is missing or unreadable. This date helps the payer determine whether the current service is covered under the right benefit period or setting.
action: Confirm the prior discharge date from the facility record and resubmit the claim.

title: Prior Placement Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date of the patient's earlier placement (for example, into a facility or program) is not present or is unusable. Payers use this date to evaluate the timing and appropriateness of the current service.
action: Supply the correct prior placement date on a corrected claim.

title: Re-evaluation Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The claim is missing a readable date for the patient's re-evaluation. This date is needed to show that the required reassessment occurred within the coverage timeframe.
action: Add the documented re-evaluation date and resubmit the claim.

title: Referral Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date of the referral that supports this service is absent or not in a readable format. The payer needs it to verify the referral was in place when the service was rendered.
action: Provide the correct referral date on a corrected claim or with the supporting documentation.

title: Replacement Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The claim does not include a usable date for when an item was replaced. Replacement dates are required to confirm the equipment or device was due for replacement under the payer's schedule.
action: Enter the accurate replacement date and resubmit the claim.

title: Secondary Diagnosis Date Missing
plain: The date associated with the secondary diagnosis is missing or unreadable on the claim. The payer needs this date to assess how the secondary condition relates to the service billed.
action: Add the documented secondary diagnosis date and resubmit.

title: Shipped Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date the item was shipped is absent from the claim or was entered incorrectly. Shipping dates matter for determining the date of service on ordered items and equipment.
action: Provide the correct shipped date and rebill the claim.

title: Similar Illness or Symptom Date Missing
plain: The claim is missing a readable date for a prior similar illness or symptom. The payer uses this date to evaluate whether the current treatment is a repeat of an earlier, related condition.
action: Document and submit the date of the prior similar illness or symptom.

title: Subscriber Birth Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The subscriber's date of birth is missing or does not match what the payer has on file. This is a common cause of claim rejection because the birth date is used to confirm the member's identity.
action: Verify the subscriber's date of birth against the eligibility record and correct the claim.

title: Surgery Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date the surgery was performed is not present or is unreadable on the claim. A valid surgery date is needed for the payer to confirm the procedure occurred and to apply the correct global period.
action: Submit the correct surgery date on a corrected claim.

title: Test Performed Date Missing or Invalid
plain: The date the test was performed is absent or entered in a format the payer cannot process. The payer needs it to confirm the test was done during the covered timeframe.
action: Add the actual test performance date and resubmit the claim.

title: TENS Trial Start Date Missing
plain: The start date of the Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulator (TENS) trial is missing or unreadable. Payers need this date to verify when the required trial period began, since a documented trial must occur before a TENS unit can be covered.
action: Provide the documented TENS trial start date and resubmit the claim.

title: TENS Trial End Date Missing
plain: The end date of the Transcutaneous Electrical Nerve Stimulator (TENS) trial is missing or not in a usable format. Without it, the payer cannot verify how long the trial lasted or whether the coverage criteria for the device were met.
action: Supply the documented TENS trial end date on a corrected claim.

title: Invalid Date Range With Units
plain: The date range you submitted does not match the units billed. Check that the dates and units are consistent with the service.
action: Verify and resubmit the date range and units so they match.

title: Missing Oral Cavity Designation Code
plain: The oral cavity designation code is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Submit the correct code so the claim can be processed.
action: Submit a valid oral cavity designation code.

title: Referred Service Already Paid
plain: Payment for this referred or purchased service was already made to another provider by the payer's payment contractor, so this claim cannot be paid.
action: Verify whether another provider was already paid for the same service; contact the payer if you believe this is incorrect.

title: Different Practitioner Billing Chosen
plain: You indicated that this service, supply, or drug would be both provided and billed by a different practitioner or supplier. Confirm that this arrangement was intended.
action: Confirm the correct rendering and billing provider; correct the claim if submitted in error.

title: Administration Method And Drug Needed
plain: The claim must include both the administration method and the drug to be adjudicated. Add these details and resubmit.
action: Report the administration method and drug on the claim.

title: Missing NOC Or Unlisted Description
plain: A description is missing, incomplete, or invalid for a Not Otherwise Classified or Unlisted/By Report procedure. Provide a clear description of the service performed.
action: Submit a complete description of the NOC or unlisted service.

title: Service Date Outside Treatment Plan
plain: The date of service falls outside the approved treatment plan service dates. Verify the authorized dates or obtain a new approval before billing.
action: Confirm or update the treatment plan authorization dates.

title: No Scheduled Payments For Service
plain: The payer has no scheduled payments for this service and expects a claim for each patient visit. Submit a separate claim for each visit.
action: Submit a claim for each patient visit.

title: Estimated Benefits Pending Actual Services
plain: The benefits shown are only an estimate; once the actual services are rendered, the payer will consider additional payment based on the claim. Submit the claim with the actual services.
action: Submit the claim after services are rendered for final payment consideration.

title: Incomplete Or Invalid Invoice
plain: The invoice submitted is incomplete or invalid. Provide a complete, valid invoice to support the claim.
action: Submit a complete and valid invoice.

title: Refund Requirement And Appeal Rights
plain: This notice explains the two exceptions that may let you keep payment instead of refunding the patient, and your appeal rights. You may appeal up to 120 days after this notice, but only an appeal filed within 30 days lets you delay the refund while it is reviewed.
action: Check whether a refund exception applies; if appealing, file within 30 days to delay the refund.

title: Non-Covered Service Relationship Denial
plain: The service is not covered when it is performed with, or after, a non-covered service. Review the related non-covered service and correct or appeal the claim if appropriate.
action: Review the related non-covered service and appeal if coverage applies.

title: Time Frame Requirement Not Met
plain: The required time interval between this service and a related service, procedure, or supply was not met. Verify the dates and submit documentation if the timing was medically appropriate.
action: Check the required interval and appeal with supporting documentation if appropriate.

title: Review With Additional Documentation
plain: This decision may be reviewed if you submit additional documentation as described in the contract or plan benefit documents. Send the required records if you want the payer to reconsider.
action: Submit the specified documentation for review.

title: Missing Incomplete Invalid Height
plain: The height reported is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Submit a valid height so the claim can be processed.
action: Submit a valid height.

title: COB Missing on Predetermination
plain: This pre-determination estimate did not account for other insurance. When you file the secondary claim, include the primary payer's payment information.
action: Submit primary payer payment information with the secondary claim.

title: Units Exceed Acceptable Maximum
plain: The days or units billed are more than the payer's allowed maximum. Review the service units and correct them if they are wrong.
action: Verify and correct the days/units billed, then resubmit if appropriate.

title: Future Policy Change Notice
plain: The payer is warning that it will soon change policies or procedures that could affect this decision. Keep this alert in mind if the claim is reviewed again.
action: Monitor payer updates for the upcoming policy change.

title: Waive Deductible and Coinsurance
plain: Your agreement with the payer requires you to waive the deductible and/or coinsurance for this service. Do not collect those amounts from the patient.
action: Adjust the claim to waive deductible/coinsurance per contract.

title: Requested Information Not Provided
plain: The payer did not receive information it requested, so the claim was denied. If you submit the requested information within one year from this notice, the payer will reopen the claim.
action: Send the requested information within one year of this notice.

title: Sent to Consumer Spending Account
plain: The claim was forwarded to a consumer spending account processor, such as an FSA or HSA. That processor will review the claim.
action: No action - informational.

title: Appeal Prior Claim Determination
plain: The payer requires you to appeal the decision on a claim it already finished processing (adjudicated). Use the appeal process for that earlier claim.
action: File an appeal on the previously adjudicated claim.

title: Claim Deficient Under State Law
plain: The claim was processed, but it does not meet state legislation or regulation requirements. Review the state rule that applies.
action: Review the state requirement and correct the claim or process going forward.

title: Rental Months Exceed Coverage
plain: You billed more rental months than the payer covers or approved. Only the approved rental months are covered.
action: Stop billing beyond the approved rental months; rebill only covered months if needed.

title: Transfer Equipment Title to Patient
plain: The payer requires that title/ownership of this equipment be transferred to the patient. This is a condition of coverage for the equipment.
action: Transfer the equipment title to the patient as required.

title: Only Reasonable Maintenance Covered
plain: The payer covers only maintenance or service charges that are reasonable and necessary. Other maintenance/service charges are not covered.
action: Bill only covered maintenance/service charges and document they are reasonable and necessary.

title: Wrong Primary Payer Refund
plain: Another payer paid these services as primary when it was not actually primary. The payer is refunding that other payer.
action: Review coordination of benefits and update primary payer information if needed.

title: Medicare Part B RA Required
plain: Medicare Part A benefits are exhausted, so a Part B remittance advice is needed. Submit the Part B remittance advice with the claim.
action: Submit the Medicare Part B remittance advice.

title: Missing Dependent Eligibility Information
plain: The payer needs a questionnaire or other information to determine if the dependent is eligible. The information provided was missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid dependent eligibility information.

title: Active Duty TRICARE May Be Primary
plain: The subscriber or patient is on active military duty, so TRICARE may be the primary payer. Verify the correct primary coverage before billing.
action: Verify TRICARE and other coverage, and bill the correct primary payer.

title: Payment from replacement claim
plain: This payment is based on a replacement claim that has already been processed.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing, incomplete, or invalid Rx quantity
plain: The prescription quantity is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected claim with a valid prescription quantity.

title: Claim and line mismatch
plain: The information submitted at the claim level does not match the information on the service lines.
action: Correct the discrepancy and resubmit the claim.

title: Original processed, submit corrected
plain: The original claim has already been processed. If you need to change it, submit a corrected claim.
action: Submit a corrected claim if changes are needed.

title: Consult contract for restrictions
plain: Your contractual agreement contains restrictions or billing and payment rules for these charges.
action: Review the contract for these charges.

title: Missing or invalid patient identifier
plain: The patient identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected claim with a valid patient identifier.

title: Not covered if cosmetic
plain: This service is not covered when it is considered cosmetic.
action: If it is not cosmetic, submit documentation to support coverage.

title: Body part previously removed
plain: Records show the referenced body part or tooth was removed in an earlier procedure.
action: Verify the records and rebill only if the service is still valid.

title: Late admission notification
plain: The admission notification was not sent within the timeframe required by the plan.
action: Review plan rules and provide proof of timely notification if available.

title: NCD-based coverage decision
plain: The decision is based on a Medicare National Coverage Determination (NCD), which states whether the item or service is covered.
action: Look up the NCD on CMS.gov for details.

title: Send to other insurer
plain: Submit this claim to the patient's other insurer for possible supplemental benefits. This payer did not forward the claim information.
action: Send the claim to the patient's other insurer.

title: Missing or invalid Rx number
plain: The prescription number is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected claim with a valid prescription number.

title: Duplicate prescription number
plain: The same prescription number was submitted more than once.
action: Check the prescription number and submit a corrected claim if needed.

title: Cannot bill separately
plain: This service or report cannot be billed separately from another service.
action: Bill it with the primary service or adjust the claim.

title: Missing emergency department records
plain: The claim is missing the emergency department records.
action: Submit the missing emergency department records.

title: Incomplete or Invalid ED Records
plain: The payer needs the emergency department records, but the records sent are incomplete or invalid.
action: Send complete, valid emergency department records.

title: Missing Progress Notes Report
plain: The claim is missing progress notes or a progress report.
action: Submit the missing progress notes or report.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Progress Notes
plain: The progress notes or report are incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete, valid progress notes or report.

title: Missing Laboratory Report
plain: The claim is missing a laboratory report.
action: Submit the missing laboratory report.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Lab Report
plain: The laboratory report provided is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid laboratory report.

title: No Benefits for Incomplete Service
plain: No benefits are available when the service was not completed or the item was not delivered.
action: Confirm completion or delivery and send documentation; otherwise remove or adjust the charge.

title: Missing Elective Consent Form
plain: The claim is missing an elective consent form.
action: Obtain and submit the missing elective consent form.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Consent Form
plain: The elective consent form is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid elective consent form.

title: Electronic Claim Submission Reminder
plain: This is an alert that providers who can file electronically should submit claims electronically.
action: Submit claims electronically if the practice can do so.

title: Missing Periodontal Charting
plain: The claim is missing periodontal charting.
action: Submit the missing periodontal charting.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Periodontal Charting
plain: The periodontal charting provided is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid periodontal charting.

title: Missing Facility Certification
plain: The claim is missing facility certification.
action: Submit the missing facility certification.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Facility Certification
plain: The facility certification provided is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid facility certification.

title: Covered Only When Donor's Insurer Does Not Cover
plain: Coverage for this service applies only when the donor's insurer or insurers do not cover it.
action: Check the donor's coverage first and send the donor insurer's denial if it does not cover the service.

title: Covered Only When Recipient's Insurer Does Not Cover
plain: Coverage for this service applies only when the recipient's insurer or insurers do not cover it.
action: Check the recipient's coverage first and send the recipient insurer's denial if it does not cover the service.

title: Not approved for transmission format
plain: This payer says you are not approved to submit claims in this transmission format. The claim was not accepted from you in that format.
action: Verify approval for this transmission format or resubmit in an approved format.

title: Prior payer deductible not covered
plain: A previous payer applied a deductible, and this payer will not cover that amount. The prior payer's deductible is not a covered charge here.
action: Review coordination of benefits and do not bill this payer for the prior payer's deductible.

title: Accident-related service time limit
plain: The payer considers this service related to an accidental injury and only covers it if it was provided within a certain time after the accident. If it was outside that time frame, it is not covered.
action: Verify the accident date and time limit, and submit documentation if within the covered timeframe.

title: Coverage requires prescription change
plain: This service is not covered with the current prescription. The payer will cover it only if the prescription is changed.
action: Obtain a changed prescription if clinically appropriate and resubmit with documentation.

title: Once per 6 months
plain: The payer covers this service only once every six months. A second service within that six-month period is not allowed.
action: Check the prior service date and resubmit only after the 6-month limit.

title: Twice per 12 months
plain: The payer covers this service up to two times in a 12-month period. More than two times in that period is not allowed.
action: Confirm prior use and do not exceed the 2-in-12-month limit without appeal.

title: Twice per benefit year
plain: The payer covers this service two times in a benefit year. Additional services in the same benefit year are not covered.
action: Check the benefit-year dates and prior use before resubmitting.

title: Four times per 12 months
plain: The payer covers this service up to four times in a 12-month period. Any more than four times is not covered.
action: Verify prior usage and appeal with documentation if additional services were needed.

title: Once per 18 months
plain: The payer covers this service once in an 18-month period. Repeat services within that period are not allowed.
action: Check the last service date and resubmit only after the 18-month limit.

title: Once per 3 years
plain: The payer covers this service once in a three-year period. More frequent services are not covered.
action: Verify the prior date and resubmit only after the 3-year limit.

title: Once per 5 years
plain: The payer covers this service once in a five-year period. Additional services within that five-year period are not covered.
action: Check the prior service date and resubmit only after the 5-year limit.

title: Claim sent to wrong payer
plain: The claim was sent to the wrong destination or payer. The payer's claim submission instructions explain where it should go.
action: Follow the payer's claim submission instructions and route the claim correctly.

title: Retroactive rate change adjustment
plain: This payment is a retroactive adjustment because the payer changed its rates after the original claim was processed. It reflects the rate change applied later.
action: No action — informational.

title: COB or liability recovery adjustment
plain: This payment is a retroactive adjustment because of coordination of benefits or a third-party liability recovery. It corrects the payment based on other coverage or liability.
action: No action — informational.

title: Review organization decision adjustment
plain: This payment is a retroactive adjustment because a review organization made a decision about the claim. It reflects that decision applied after the original payment.
action: No action — informational.

title: Contract incentive retroactive payment
plain: This payment was changed retroactively because of an incentive program in the payer's contract.
action: Review the incentive program terms and reconcile the retroactive payment.

title: Non-standard retroactive payment adjustment
plain: The payer changed this payment retroactively under a non-standard program.
