action: Ask the payer for details if the non-standard adjustment is unclear.

title: Patient outside required geographic area
plain: The patient does not live in the geographic area the payer requires for this payment.
action: Verify the patient's residence and the payer's geographic requirements, and appeal if the address is correct.

title: Statutorily excluded service
plain: The service is excluded from coverage by law.
action: Confirm the statutory exclusion and bill the patient only if proper notice exists.

title: Self-administered drug not covered
plain: The payer does not cover this drug when the patient can administer it themselves.
action: Check whether the drug was provider-administered, correct the claim if it was, and otherwise bill the patient as allowed.

title: Eyeglasses after cataract surgery only
plain: Eyeglasses or contact lenses are covered only when the patient has had cataract surgery.
action: Verify cataract surgery history and submit supporting documentation if the service should be covered.

title: Place of service coverage restriction
plain: The payer will not pay for this service when it is performed in this type of location or setting.
action: Check the place of service and rebill if the service was performed in a covered setting.

title: Routine service not covered
plain: The payer considers this service routine and therefore non-covered.
action: Review the documentation to show the service was not routine, then appeal if appropriate.

title: Units inconsistent with procedure
plain: The number of units billed does not match the procedure code.
action: Correct the units or procedure code and resubmit the claim.

title: Procedure not covered together
plain: This service is not covered when billed with the other procedure on the claim.
action: Review the bundling edit, then remove the service or appeal with a modifier or documentation if supported.

title: Recovery Audit adjustment
plain: This payment was adjusted because of a Recovery Audit.
action: Review the audit findings and appeal by the deadline if the adjustment is wrong.

title: Resubmit using NPI only
plain: The claim must be resubmitted using only the National Provider Identifier.
action: Remove other provider identifiers and resubmit the claim with only the NPI.

title: Invalid Present on Admission indicator
plain: The claim is missing a valid Present on Admission indicator, which shows whether the patient's condition was already present when they were admitted to the hospital.
action: Correct the Present on Admission indicator and resubmit the claim.

title: Frequency exceeds approved limit
plain: The number or frequency of services is more than the payer allows for this period, and no supporting records were sent.
action: Send supporting documentation or appeal if the frequency was medically necessary.

title: Injury claim not accepted
plain: The injury claim has not been accepted by the responsible payer, but a mandatory medical payment was still made.
action: Coordinate with the injury payer and update the claim if another payer is responsible.

title: Injury Claim Reconsideration Alert
plain: This is a notice that if the related injury claim is accepted, these charges will be reconsidered for payment at that time.
action: Monitor the injury claim decision; once the claim is accepted, follow up to confirm the charges are reconsidered.

title: Paper Claims Only Requirement
plain: This jurisdiction does not accept electronic claims, so claims must be sent on paper.
action: Submit the claim on paper according to the jurisdiction's requirement.

title: Missing Anesthesia Physical Status
plain: The claim does not include the anesthesia physical status report or the required physical status indicators.
action: Obtain and submit the missing anesthesia physical status report or indicators.

title: Invalid Anesthesia Physical Status
plain: The anesthesia physical status report or indicators were submitted but are incomplete or invalid, so they could not be accepted.
action: Correct the information or submit a complete, valid anesthesia physical status report.

title: Missed/Cancelled Appointment Not Covered
plain: The payer does not cover charges for a missed or cancelled appointment.
action: Do not bill the payer for the missed or cancelled appointment; follow practice policy for any patient charge.

title: Alternate Fee Schedule Payment
plain: Reimbursement was calculated using a different fee schedule than the standard or expected one.
action: Check which fee schedule applies and adjust expected reimbursement accordingly.

title: Missing or Invalid Time Data
plain: The claim lacks total time or begin/end time, or the submitted time information is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid total time or begin/end time details.

title: High Cost Outlier Form Not Filed
plain: The facility has not submitted the Election for High Cost Outlier form that the Division of Workers' Compensation requires, so high-cost outlier payment may be at risk.
action: File the Election for High Cost Outlier form with the Division of Workers' Compensation if outlier payment is sought.

title: Missing Actual Cost Documentation
plain: Documentation needed to verify the actual cost or paid amount was not submitted.
action: Send the missing documentation that supports the actual cost or paid amount.

title: Invalid Actual Cost Documentation
plain: The documentation supporting the actual cost or paid amount is incomplete or invalid.
action: Replace it with complete, valid documentation for the actual cost or paid amount.

title: Generic Equivalent Payment Applied
plain: Payment was reduced to the generic equivalent rate because the documentation needed to support the item as billed (such as a brand-name drug) was not submitted.
action: Provide the required documentation if payment at the brand-name rate is being requested.

title: Item Not in Fee Schedule
plain: There is no established rate for this drug, service, or supply because it does not appear in the applicable fee schedule or contracted/legislated fee arrangement.
action: Review the fee schedule and contract; bill according to the applicable arrangement or adjust the charge.

title: Comparable Item Payment Basis
plain: Payment was based on a comparable drug, service, or supply rather than the specific item billed.
action: Review the comparable item used and appeal if the comparison is not appropriate.

title: Primary Physician or Designee Requirement
plain: The service is covered only when it is performed by the primary treating physician or that physician's designee.
action: Verify and document that the primary treating physician or designee performed the service.

title: Missing Admission Summary Report
plain: The claim is missing the admission summary report.
action: Submit the missing admission summary report.

title: Incomplete Admission Summary Report
plain: The admission summary report submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid admission summary report to the payer.

title: Missing Consultation Report
plain: The claim is missing a required consultation report.
action: Submit the missing consultation report to the payer.

title: Incomplete Consultation Report
plain: The consultation report submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid consultation report to the payer.

title: Missing Physician Order
plain: The claim is missing a required physician order.
action: Submit the missing physician order to the payer.

title: Incomplete Physician Order
plain: The physician order submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid physician order to the payer.

title: Missing Diagnostic Report
plain: The claim is missing a required diagnostic report.
action: Submit the missing diagnostic report to the payer.

title: Incomplete Diagnostic Report
plain: The diagnostic report submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid diagnostic report to the payer.

title: Missing Discharge Summary
plain: The claim is missing a required discharge summary.
action: Submit the missing discharge summary to the payer.

title: Incomplete Discharge Summary
plain: The discharge summary submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid discharge summary to the payer.

title: Missing Nursing Notes
plain: The claim is missing required nursing notes.
action: Submit the missing nursing notes to the payer.

title: Incomplete Nursing Notes
plain: The nursing notes submitted with the claim are incomplete or invalid.
action: Send complete, valid nursing notes to the payer.

title: Missing Claim Support Data
plain: The payer does not have the supporting documentation needed to process the claim.
action: Send the documentation that supports the billed services (for example, medical records, test results, or itemized statements) to the payer; if you are unsure what is needed, contact the payer to confirm.

title: Incomplete Claim Support Data
plain: The supporting documentation sent with the claim is incomplete or was not accepted as valid.
action: Review the supporting documentation (such as medical records or itemized statements) for missing or incorrect details, fix it, and resend it to the payer.

title: Missing Physical Therapy Notes
plain: The claim is missing required physical therapy notes or report.
action: Submit the missing physical therapy notes or report to the payer.

title: Incomplete Physical Therapy Notes
plain: The physical therapy notes or report submitted with the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send complete, valid physical therapy notes or report to the payer.

title: Missing tests and analysis report
plain: The payer did not receive a required tests and analysis report with the claim.
action: Submit the missing tests and analysis report to the payer.

title: Incomplete invalid analysis report
plain: The tests and analysis report that was submitted is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid tests and analysis report.

title: MMA appeal process applies
plain: This claim or service is subject to an appeal process under section 935 of the Medicare Prescription Drug, Improvement, and Modernization Act of 2003.
action: Review appeal rights and follow the MMA section 935 appeal process if appealing.

title: Mandatory reimbursement limit completed
plain: This payment brings the total reimbursement to the required mandatory medical reimbursement limit.
action: No action - informational.

title: Missing invalid HIPPS rate code
plain: The HIPPS rate code on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct HIPPS rate code.

title: Paid to another provider
plain: The payer issued payment for this service to a different provider.
action: Check whether another provider should have received payment; rebill only if payment was routed incorrectly.

title: Missing required certification
plain: A required certification was not submitted or is not on file.
action: Obtain and submit the required certification.

title: Incomplete or invalid certification
plain: The certification is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected and valid certification.

title: Missing completed referral form
plain: A completed referral form was not submitted.
action: Submit the completed referral form.

title: Incomplete invalid referral form
plain: The completed referral form is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a corrected and completed referral form.

title: Missing dental models
plain: Required dental models were not submitted.
action: Submit the missing dental models.

title: Incomplete invalid dental models
plain: The dental models are incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid dental models.

title: Missing COB or MSP EOB
plain: An Explanation of Benefits for coordination of benefits or Medicare Secondary Payer is missing.
action: Submit the missing Explanation of Benefits or COB/MSP documentation.

title: Incomplete invalid COB/MSP EOB
plain: The Explanation of Benefits for coordination of benefits or Medicare Secondary Payer is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid Explanation of Benefits or COB/MSP documentation.

title: Missing required models
plain: Required models are missing from the submission.
action: Submit the missing models.

title: Incomplete or invalid models
plain: The models submitted with the claim were incomplete or invalid, so the payer could not use them. Models are the physical molds or representations (such as dental casts) used to plan or support certain devices and services.
action: Send complete, usable models that meet the payer's requirements.

title: Missing physical therapy certification
plain: The claim is for physical therapy, but the certification that documents and supports the therapy plan was not sent with it.
action: Submit the physical therapy certification, signed and dated as required.

title: Invalid physical therapy certification
plain: A physical therapy certification was received, but it is incomplete or does not contain valid information, so it cannot be accepted as-is.
action: Correct the certification, supply missing elements, and resubmit it with the claim.

title: Missing prosthetics or orthotics certification
plain: The claim is for a prosthetic or orthotic item, but the required certification supporting it was not included.
action: Submit the prosthetics or orthotics certification with the claim.

title: Invalid prosthetics or orthotics certification
plain: A prosthetics or orthotics certification was sent, but it is incomplete or invalid and cannot be used to support the claim.
action: Fix the incomplete or invalid certification and resubmit it.

title: Missing referral form
plain: The payer requires a referral form for this service, and it was not received.
action: Obtain and submit the required referral form.

title: Incomplete or invalid referral form
plain: A referral form was submitted, but it is missing required information or is otherwise not valid.
action: Correct or complete the referral form and resubmit it.

title: Exclusionary rider issue
plain: Information about an exclusionary rider condition is missing, incomplete, or invalid. An exclusionary rider is a policy provision that limits or excludes coverage for a specific condition.
action: Provide the missing or corrected exclusionary rider information so the payer can determine coverage.

title: Member may be billed
plain: A network provider is permitted to bill the member for this service if the member asked for it and agreed in writing before receiving it to be financially responsible for the charge.
action: Confirm you have the member's signed advance agreement before billing the member for the service.

title: Missing doctor first injury report
plain: The Doctor's First Report of Injury, used in workers' compensation cases, was not submitted with the claim.
action: Submit the Doctor's First Report of Injury.

title: Invalid doctor first injury report
plain: The Doctor's First Report of Injury was received but is incomplete or contains invalid information.
action: Complete or correct the Doctor's First Report of Injury and resubmit it.

title: Missing supplemental medical report
plain: The supplemental medical report required to support this claim was not sent.
action: Submit the supplemental medical report.

title: Invalid supplemental medical report
plain: The supplemental medical report that was submitted is incomplete or invalid and cannot be accepted.
action: Correct or complete the supplemental medical report and resubmit it.

title: Missing permanent impairment report
plain: The Medical Permanent Impairment or Disability Report needed for this claim was not received.
action: Submit the Medical Permanent Impairment or Disability Report.

title: Invalid permanent impairment report
plain: The Medical Permanent Impairment or Disability Report was submitted, but it is incomplete or invalid.
action: Correct or complete the Medical Permanent Impairment or Disability Report and resubmit it.

title: Medical Legal Report Missing
plain: A required medical legal report is not on file.
action: Obtain and submit the missing Medical Legal Report.

title: Medical Legal Report Invalid
plain: The Medical Legal Report was received but is missing required information or contains errors, so it was not accepted.
action: Review the report, supply the missing or corrected information, and resubmit it.

title: Vocational Report Missing
plain: A required vocational report is missing.
action: Obtain and submit the missing Vocational Report.

title: Vocational Report Invalid
plain: The Vocational Report was received but is missing required information or contains errors, so it was not accepted.
action: Review the report, supply the missing or corrected information, and resubmit it.

title: Work Status Report Missing
plain: A required work status report is missing.
action: Obtain and submit the missing Work Status Report.

title: Work Status Report Invalid
plain: The Work Status Report was received but is missing required information or contains errors, so it was not accepted.
action: Review the report, supply the missing or corrected information, and resubmit it.

title: Real-Time Estimate Limited
plain: This real-time response only includes services that could be estimated right away. Services that could not be estimated in real time will not receive an estimate here.
action: No action - informational.

title: Estimate Not Guaranteed
plain: This is an estimate of the member's possible liability based on information available when it was processed. Actual coverage and member liability are set when the claim is processed, and this is not a pre-authorization or payment guarantee.
action: Use only as an estimate; verify benefits and do not guarantee payment.

title: Plan Distance Requirements Unmet
plain: The plan's distance requirements were not satisfied.
action: Check plan distance rules and resubmit or appeal if requirements are met.

title: Real-Time Member Responsibility
plain: This real-time adjudication response shows the member responsibility for the reported services. The member will receive an Explanation of Benefits from the insurer.
action: No action - informational; member will receive an EOB.

title: Spending Account Funds Sufficient
plain: A current check shows the member's Consumer Spending Account has enough funds to cover this liability. Actual payment still depends on funds being available and the services being eligible when payment is processed.
action: Do not guarantee funds; verify account eligibility and availability at payment.

title: Spending Account Funds Insufficient
plain: A current check shows insufficient funds in the member's Consumer Spending Account to cover this liability. Actual payment still depends on funds being available and the services being eligible when payment is processed.
action: Inform the member funds may be insufficient; do not guarantee payment.

title: Spending Account Funds Unknown
plain: Information about whether the member's Consumer Spending Account has funds for this liability is not available right now.
action: No action - informational; recheck account funds later if needed.

title: Initial Remit No Change
plain: This is the first remittance for a non-NCPDP claim that was originally submitted in real time. The adjudication did not change.
action: No action - informational.

title: Initial Remit With Change
plain: This is the first remittance for a non-NCPDP claim that was originally submitted in real time. The adjudication changed.
action: Review the remit for the adjudication change.

title: NPI and EIN Mismatch
plain: The NPI submitted on the claim does not match the EIN on file. The payer cannot tie the provider's identifier to the tax ID it has.
action: Verify the NPI and EIN, then correct and resubmit the claim.

title: Resubmit Claim With Information
plain: The payer needs more information to process this claim. Submit a new claim that includes the requested details.
action: Send a new claim that includes the details the payer asked for.

title: Oxygen Accessory No Separate Pay
plain: Accessories supplied for use with oxygen equipment are not paid on their own. Their cost is treated as part of the payment for the oxygen equipment itself.
action: Do not bill the accessories separately; include them with the oxygen equipment claim.

title: Invalid HCPCS Modifier Combination
plain: The HCPCS modifiers used on this claim are not a valid combination. The payer cannot process the service with these modifiers.
action: Check the modifiers, correct the invalid combination, and resubmit the claim.

title: Consumer Spending Account Payment
plain: This payment came from a consumer spending account, such as an HSA or FSA. It is informational and does not indicate a payer denial.
action: No action — informational.

title: Provider Information Mismatch
plain: The provider information submitted does not match what the payer has on file. This can happen with names, addresses, or identifiers.
action: Review and update the provider information on file or correct the claim, then resubmit.

title: Duplicate Crossover Claim
plain: This claim is a duplicate of one already processed or pending as a crossover claim. The payer is not treating it as a new claim.
action: Do not resubmit; confirm the crossover claim and keep the remittance for records.

title: Outlier Payment Limit Reached
plain: The payer has reached its outlier payment limit for this service period. The extra outlier payment that would normally apply was not paid.
action: No action — informational.

title: Payment in Full by Policy
plain: Under the payer's policy, this payment is the full amount owed for the service. The provider should not expect additional payment from the payer.
action: Accept the payment as full per policy; do not balance bill the patient unless allowed.

title: Services Within Global Period
plain: The service was performed during the global period of another procedure. The payer does not cover it separately during that time.
action: Do not bill the service separately; review the global period and combine with the primary service if appropriate.

title: Not Qualified Employer Size
plain: Recovery does not apply to this claim because of the employer's size. In practice this usually means the employer is below the employee-count threshold that would make its group health plan pay primary.
action: No action — informational.

title: Primary Payer Before Recovery
plain: The claim had already been processed and paid as primary before the recovery demand arrived, so the original primary processing stands.
action: No action — informational.

title: Institutional Services Only Benefits
plain: The patient has benefits for institutional services only. Professional services are not covered under this benefit.
action: Bill institutional services to this payer; check other coverage or patient responsibility for professional services.

title: Professional Services Only Benefits
plain: The patient has benefits for professional services only. Institutional services are not covered under this benefit.
action: Bill professional services to this payer; check other coverage or patient responsibility for institutional services.

title: Not Qualified Enrollment Information
plain: The recovery does not qualify based on the enrollment information on file. The payer will not pursue recovery for this claim.
action: No action — informational.

title: Direct premium payment blocks recovery
plain: This claim is not eligible for recovery because the premium was paid directly.
action: No action — informational.

title: Disability and work status barred
plain: Recovery does not apply here because of the patient's disability and current employment status.
action: No action — informational.

title: IHS self-insured tribal plan services
plain: The patient was treated at an Indian Health Services facility, and coverage comes from a self-insured tribal Group Health Plan.
action: No action — informational.

title: Individual policy no employer sponsorship
plain: The patient has an individual policy, and the employer plays no role in sponsoring the plan.
action: No action — informational.

title: Place of service payment adjustment
plain: Your payment was recalculated because of where the service took place, using the procedure code and place of service submitted on the claim.
action: Confirm the procedure code and place of service; correct and resubmit if they are wrong.

title: Prior patient responsibility unchanged
plain: We are not changing the prior payer's patient-responsibility decision; you may collect it because this service is not covered by us.
action: You may collect the patient responsibility amount as determined by the prior payer.

title: No claims history found
plain: We checked claims history and found no record of these services.
action: Verify the claim details and submit documentation if the services were provided.

title: Facility pays outside providers
plain: The facility owes payment to any outside provider that supplied these services, supplies, or drugs to the facility's patients or residents.
action: Bill the facility for these services, supplies, or drugs.

title: Appeal or waiver denied
plain: We processed the appeal or waiver request on your behalf, and it was denied.
action: Review the denial and decide whether to pursue further appeal options.

title: Interrupted stay payment adjustment
plain: Payment was adjusted under the interrupted stay policy.
action: Review the interrupted stay policy; no action if the adjustment is correct.

title: Insurance type code mismatch
plain: The insurance type code you submitted does not match the information stored in our system.
action: Correct the insurance type code and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing income verification
plain: Income verification is missing.
action: Submit the required income verification.

title: Incomplete or invalid income verification
plain: The income verification is incomplete or invalid.
action: Provide complete, valid income verification.

title: Referring provider mismatch after payment
plain: Although this claim was paid, the referring or ordering provider you billed does not match our system record; future claims will not be paid unless corrected.
action: Verify and correct the referring/ordering provider information for future claims.

title: Unsuccessful ePrescriber payment reduction
plain: Payment was reduced because you were an unsuccessful ePrescriber under the Electronic Prescribing (eRx) Incentive Program.
action: Review eRx program requirements and correct future reporting if applicable.

title: eRx incentive prior reduction
plain: This payment amount reflects a prior reduction under the Electronic Prescribing Incentive Program.
action: Review the prior eRx adjustment; no action if it matches your records.

title: Prior refund request processed
plain: A refund request using Frequency Type Code 8 was already processed.
action: Verify the refund was expected and avoid sending a duplicate refund request.

title: Deductible has been met
plain: The patient has met their annual deductible for this calendar year.
action: No action — informational.

title: Out-of-pocket maximum met
plain: The patient has reached their annual out-of-pocket maximum for this calendar year.
action: No action — informational.

title: Provider enrollment revalidation alert
plain: The provider or supplier has not responded to enrollment revalidation requests. If this is not addressed, payments may be held soon.
action: Submit the requested revalidation information immediately.

title: ASC quality reporting adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted due to the Ambulatory Surgical Center Quality Reporting Program.
action: Check ASC quality reporting compliance and the adjustment details.

title: Prior withhold or bonus reversed
plain: The payment was changed to reverse an earlier withhold or bonus amount.
action: Confirm the previous withhold or bonus and this reversal match your records.

title: Missing family planning indicator
plain: The family planning indicator on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Correct the family planning indicator and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing medication list
plain: The claim did not include the required medication list.
action: Send the missing medication list with a corrected claim.

title: Incomplete or invalid medication list
plain: The medication list on the claim is incomplete or invalid.
action: Provide a complete, valid medication list and resubmit.

title: Specimen service area mismatch
plain: This payer cannot pay because the specimen was collected outside its service area. The claim should go to the payer for the specimen collection area.
action: File the claim with the payer or plan for where the specimen was collected.

title: Equipment service area mismatch
plain: This payer cannot pay because the equipment was received outside its service area. The claim should go to the payer for the equipment receipt area.
action: File the claim with the payer or plan for where the equipment was received.

title: Ordering physician service area mismatch
plain: This payer cannot pay because the ordering physician is outside its service area. The claim should go to the payer for the ordering physician's area.
action: File the claim with the payer or plan for the ordering physician's location.

title: Pilot admission claim not received
plain: Under this pilot program, an interim or final claim was due within 60 days after the Notice of Admission, and no claim was received.
action: Submit the required interim or final claim promptly, or contact the payer about options given the missed 60-day deadline.

title: Bundled readmission payment correction
plain: The bundled claim already submitted for this episode of care also covers related readmissions. Resubmitting that original claim lets the payer recalculate payment to account for the readmission.
action: Resubmit the original bundled claim so payment can be recalculated for the readmission.

title: Provider Number Mismatch on NOA
plain: The claim was submitted with a provider number that doesn't agree with the provider number on the Notice of Admission (NOA) already processed for this bundled payment episode.
action: Compare the claim and NOA provider numbers and correct the claim so they match.

title: Missing Advance Notice of Non-Coverage
plain: The required advance patient notice of non-coverage was not issued by the provider or supplier. As a result, the patient is not financially responsible for this service.
action: Ensure the required advance notice is issued for future non-covered services; do not bill the patient for this service.

title: Patient Not Eligible for Demo
plain: The patient doesn't qualify for the demonstration project or pilot program because they failed to meet the program's enrollment (inclusion) criteria.
action: Confirm program criteria and bill under the correct benefits if the patient qualifies elsewhere.

title: Non-Payable Code Needs Modifier
plain: This non-payable reporting code needs a modifier, but one was missing. Future claims with this code must include an appropriate modifier to process.
action: Add the appropriate modifier to the non-payable reporting code on future claims.

title: Functional Reporting Required for Procedure
plain: This procedure code calls for functional reporting. Future claims with this code must also include an applicable non-payable code and the right modifiers to be processed.
action: Submit the required non-payable code and modifiers with future claims.

title: Preventive Service Not Covered
plain: This service is not covered if it is considered preventive.
action: Check benefit and diagnosis requirements; bill as non-covered or adjust if not preventive.

title: Initial Bundled Payment Based on NOA
plain: Informational only: the first payment for this episode was calculated from the Notice of Admission (NOA) under the Bundled Payment Model IV initiative.
action: No action - informational.

title: Not Covered for Reported Diagnosis
plain: The procedure was denied because the diagnosis on the claim is not a covered reason to perform it; coverage depends on the diagnosis reported.
action: Review the diagnosis coding and rebill if another covered diagnosis applies.

title: Invalid Credentialing Data
plain: The payer found a problem with the provider's credentialing information - it may be absent, incomplete, or not valid - and it must be corrected before the claim can proceed.
action: Verify and update the provider credentialing data, then resubmit.

title: Quarterly Payment by Other Payer
plain: Another payer or contractor will pay this claim on a quarterly basis.
action: No action - informational; track payment with the other payer or contractor.

title: Procedure Requires Reporting Codes and Modifiers
plain: Payment for this procedure is conditional: the claim must also carry the required non-payable reporting codes with their associated modifiers, otherwise the procedure will not be reimbursed.
action: Add the required non-payable reporting codes and modifiers and resubmit.

title: Overpayment Refund Required
plain: You were paid too much and must return the overpayment. A separate refund request will come from another payer or contractor.
action: Watch for the separate refund request and return the overpayment promptly.

title: Ordering/Referring Provider Cannot Order
plain: The payer's records show the ordering or referring provider has a provider type or specialty that isn't permitted to order or refer services. Confirm the right ordering/referring provider was reported on the claim, or follow up with that provider.
action: Verify the ordering or referring provider is eligible and correct the claim if needed.

title: Ordering/Referring Provider Name Mismatch
plain: The ordering or referring provider name submitted on the claim does not match the name in our records.
action: Correct the ordering or referring provider name to match our records and resubmit.

title: Services Not Related to Incident
plain: The billed services aren't connected to the particular incident, claim, accident, or loss that was reported, so they can't be paid under that claim.
action: Review the incident or accident information and bill under the correct claim if appropriate.

title: PIP Coverage Applies
plain: This claim is being handled under Personal Injury Protection, an auto coverage that can pay medical bills after an accident regardless of fault.
action: No action — informational.

title: Loss Not Covered
plain: None of the available insurance coverages apply to this accident or loss.
action: Review the loss details and bill the correct coverage or patient if no coverage applies.

title: Medical Payments Coverage
plain: This claim is being handled under Medical Payments Coverage, an auto medical benefit that pays covered accident-related bills up to the policy limit.
action: No action — informational.

title: Policy Provisions Determination
plain: The payer decided this claim based on the terms of the insurance policy.
action: Review the policy and appeal if the determination appears incorrect.

title: Coverage Eligibility Pending
plain: The payer is still investigating whether the patient is eligible for coverage.
action: Wait for the investigation or send requested eligibility information.

title: Benefits Suspended Patient Cooperation
plain: Benefits are on hold until the patient provides requested cooperation.
action: Contact the patient and obtain the cooperation the payer needs.

title: Not Occupant Of Insured Vehicle
plain: The patient was not inside the vehicle covered by this policy, so the patient is not eligible under it.
action: Verify the accident details and bill the correct auto policy or patient.

title: Noncompliance With Policy Conditions
plain: Coverage is denied because the insured did not meet policy or legal conditions.
action: Review the denial and appeal with proof that policy or statutory conditions were met, if available.

title: Benefits Ended By Settlement
plain: Benefits are no longer available because the injury claim was settled.
action: Check the settlement for medical allocation and bill any other responsible payer.

title: Injured Party Not Eligible
plain: The injured person does not meet the requirements for these benefits.
action: Verify eligibility and bill the correct payer or patient if the denial stands.

title: Policy Benefits Exhausted
plain: The policy's benefits have been used up.
action: Bill other coverage or the patient for any remaining balance.

title: Patient Refuses Claim Payment
plain: The patient has told the payer not to pay medical claims or bills.
action: Contact the patient to resolve the payment instruction before billing.

title: Intoxication Or Drug Exclusion
plain: Coverage is excluded for injuries from operating a vehicle while intoxicated or impaired by drugs.
action: Verify the facts and bill the patient or another payer if the exclusion applies.

title: Missing Independent Medical Exam
plain: The payer needs an independent medical exam report explaining injury cause and why services were medically necessary.
action: Obtain and submit the independent medical exam or supporting documentation.

title: Payment Based On IME/UR
plain: The payment decision was made after an independent medical exam or utilization review.
action: Review the IME/UR findings and appeal if the payment decision is not supported.

title: Initial Prescription Limit Adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted because the drug or supply is not the first prescription in the benefit or it exceeds what is allowed for an initial prescription.
action: Review the initial-prescription limits and correct or rebill if the drug or supply qualifies.

title: Missed Independent Medical Exam
plain: The service is not covered because the injured party did not attend a scheduled Independent Medical Exam.
action: Contact the payer to arrange or complete the Independent Medical Exam.

title: Missing Application for Benefits
plain: The injured person has not completed the Application for Benefits required for this loss.
action: Obtain and submit the completed Application for Benefits.

title: Missing Assignment of Benefits
plain: The injured person has not completed the Assignment of Benefits required for this loss.
action: Obtain and submit the signed Assignment of Benefits.

title: Missing Medical Authorization
plain: The injured person has not completed the Medical Authorization required for this loss.
action: Obtain and submit the completed Medical Authorization.

title: Care Apportionment Adjustment
plain: Payment was reduced because the provider divided the care between injuries related to this claim and other unrelated medical or dental conditions or injuries.
action: Review the apportionment and provide documentation supporting how care was divided.

title: Health Coverage Is Primary
plain: The health care policy is primary for this service.
action: Bill the health plan first and submit its EOB with any secondary claim.

title: Florida No-Fault Reasonable Payment
plain: Payment was set at a reasonable amount under the policy and Florida No-Fault law, calculated using 200% of the Participating Medicare Part B fee schedule for the locale where services were rendered.
action: Verify the Florida PIP reasonable amount and adjust the balance per the policy.

title: Regional Fee Schedule Adjustment
plain: The allowed amount was adjusted using the fee schedule that applies to the region where the service was provided.
action: Verify the regional fee schedule and adjust billing.

title: Hawaii Auto Medicare RBRVS
plain: For Hawaii motor vehicle insurance claims, the recommended payment follows the Medicare Resource Based Relative Value Scale (RBRVS) applicable to Hawaii, under Hawaii Administrative Rules Title 16, Chapter 23.
action: Verify the Hawaii Medicare RBRVS calculation.

title: Redbook Maximum Allowance Adjustment
plain: The allowed amount was adjusted to the maximum allowance in the Redbook.
action: Verify the Redbook maximum allowance.

title: New Jersey Auto Fee Schedule
plain: The fee follows New Jersey's medical fee schedules for Automobile Personal Injury Protection (PIP) and Motor Bus Medical Expense Insurance Coverage.
action: Verify the New Jersey auto fee schedule.

title: New York No-Fault Workers Comp Fee
plain: As required by New York No-Fault Regulation 68, the base fee comes from the New York Workers' Compensation Board Schedule of Medical Fees, per Regulation 83 and/or Appendix 17-C of 11 NYCRR.
action: Verify the New York workers' compensation fee schedule.

title: New York APR-DRG Fee
plain: The fee is based on New York's All Patients Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) methodology, as required by Regulation 68.
action: Verify the APR-DRG calculation.

title: Oregon Workers Compensation Fee Schedule
plain: Payment for this Oregon procedure follows the state Workers Compensation Fee Schedule (OAR 436-009), calculated as required by Section 4 of ORS 742.524.
action: Verify the Oregon workers' compensation fee schedule.

title: Non-compensable condition service
plain: The service was provided for a condition that is not payable or compensable.
action: Review whether the condition should be compensable; if so, submit documentation or appeal.

title: Act 6 fee calculation
plain: The allowed fee is set at 110% of the Medicare fee schedule for this region, specialty, and service type, under Act 6.
action: No action - informational.

title: Act 6 recommended payment
plain: Under Act 6, the payer is recommending payment of 80% of the billed amount.
action: No action - informational.

title: Appropriate level of care
plain: The payer paid this service based on an appropriate level of care rather than the level originally billed.
action: No action - informational.

title: Claim in litigation
plain: The claim is involved in litigation, so payment may depend on the legal case.
action: Reach out to the insurer for more information.

title: Provider not authorized in jurisdiction
plain: This provider is not recognized as authorized or certified to treat injured workers in this jurisdiction.
action: Verify the provider's authorization or certification; if valid, appeal, otherwise assign an authorized provider.

title: Ordering provider enrollment update needed
plain: The claim was paid, but the ordering provider's enrollment record needs to be updated. If the submitted ordering provider information is correct, contact that provider to update their enrollment; otherwise future claims with them may not pay.
action: Verify the ordering provider data; if correct, have the ordering provider update their enrollment record.

title: Additional 835 policy information
plain: More details about this claim are in the 835 healthcare policy identification segment.
action: Review the 835 healthcare policy identification segment for details.

title: Premium tax credit grace period
plain: The enrollee gets advance premium tax credit and is in the three-month premium grace period. Under 45 CFR 156.270, appropriate first-month claims must be paid, and second- and third-month claims may be pended.
action: Check which grace-period month applies and expect possible pends for months two and three.

title: First grace period month
plain: The member is in month one of the advance premium tax credit grace period, during which the plan must continue paying appropriate claims.
action: No action - informational.

title: Second or third grace month
plain: The member is in month two or three of the advance premium tax credit grace period, during which the plan may hold (pend) claims.
action: Expect claims to be pended; verify premium payment status.

title: Automatic reprocessing if premiums paid
plain: This claim will be reprocessed automatically if the enrollee pays their premiums.
action: No action - wait for automatic reprocessing if premiums are paid.

title: Coverage terminated for non-payment
plain: The enrollee's coverage ended because premiums were not paid.
action: Verify the termination and whether coverage can be reinstated before rebilling.

title: Quality reporting code only
plain: This procedure code appears on the claim solely for quality reporting or informational tracking.
action: No action - informational.

title: Jurisdiction forms not separately payable
plain: Charges for forms, reports, or chart notes required by the jurisdiction are not payable.
action: Do not bill separately for jurisdiction-required forms, reports, or chart notes.

title: Date of injury coverage issue
plain: The payer is denying coverage because of the date of the injury or accident.
action: Verify the injury or accident date and coverage rules, then correct or appeal if appropriate.

title: Service unproven or inappropriate
plain: This service was denied because the plan views it as unproven, outdated, experimental, excessive, or not medically appropriate.
action: Submit clinical evidence supporting the service or change to a covered alternative.

title: Workers' comp claim withdrawn
plain: The workers' compensation claim tied to this service was withdrawn, so the payer cannot process it under that claim.
action: Verify the workers' comp claim status and bill the correct responsible payer.

title: Invalid workers' comp claim number
plain: The workers' compensation claim number is missing, incomplete, or invalid, which prevents processing.
action: Get the correct workers' compensation claim number and resubmit.

title: E/M not payable with chiropractic
plain: The payer does not pay new or established patient E/M codes when they are billed together with chiropractic care codes.
action: Review the chiropractic and E/M documentation and bill only services that are separately payable.

title: Follow-up same day as test
plain: An outpatient follow-up visit is not allowed on the same date as a scheduled test or treatment.
action: Check whether the follow-up is distinct and documented, then adjust or appeal accordingly.

title: Records not requested
plain: The records or reports sent were not requested by the payer, so they are not payable.
action: Do not bill for records unless requested; remove the charge if it was submitted.

title: Referral not authorized by physician
plain: The attending physician did not authorize the referral, so the service is not covered.
action: Obtain the attending physician's authorization and resubmit the claim.

title: Code not on fee schedule
plain: This code is not listed on the medical fee schedule, so payment was allowed based on a similar service.
action: Review the comparable-service allowance and use the fee-schedule code when possible.

title: Extra anesthesia time not allowed
plain: The payer will not allow extra anesthesia time units.
action: Verify documented anesthesia time and bill only allowable time units.

title: Anesthesia allowance uses time units
plain: Payment was determined using anesthesia time units.
action: No action — informational.

title: Anesthesia base plus time
plain: Payment was determined using the anesthesia base units plus time.
action: No action — informational.

title: Reimbursable once per injury
plain: The claim was adjusted because this service can be paid only one time for the same injury.
action: Check for duplicate charges for the same injury and adjust as needed.

title: Consultation after treatment not allowed
plain: A consultation is not payable if the same provider has already treated the condition.
action: Review the documentation and bill the appropriate E/M or treatment code instead of a consultation.

title: Home health fee schedule payment
plain: Payment was made according to the home health fee schedule.
action: No action — informational.

title: Inpatient rehab facility fee schedule
plain: The payment was set using the inpatient rehabilitation facility fee schedule. This is a pricing explanation, not a denial.
action: No action — informational.

title: Frequency or number limit exceeded
plain: The service was billed more often or in a greater number than the plan allows for that time period. The amount beyond the allowed frequency is not paid.
action: Check the frequency limit and appeal with documentation if the services were medically necessary.

title: Payment based on body areas rated
plain: Payment was calculated based on how many body areas were rated. The number of areas can change the allowed amount.
action: Verify the documented body areas and appeal if the count is wrong.

title: Individual tests billed instead of panel
plain: The claim was adjusted because the tests should have been billed together as a panel rather than separately. The panel pricing applies.
action: Rebill as a panel if appropriate, or appeal with documentation supporting separate tests.

title: Not covered by state fee schedule
plain: In the applicable state fee schedule, these services are listed as not covered or non-covered. No payment is allowed under that schedule.
action: Review the state fee schedule and bill the patient only if permitted; appeal if coverage applies.

title: Bilateral procedure rule applied
plain: Payment was adjusted using the bilateral procedure rule. That rule affects reimbursement when a procedure is performed on both sides.
action: No action — informational.

title: Mark-up allowance applied
plain: A mark-up allowance was included in the reimbursement. This is an added allowance under the payer's pricing method.
action: No action — informational.

title: Assistant guidelines applied
plain: Payment was adjusted according to the payer's guidelines for an assistant. Those guidelines determine how much an assistant can be paid.
action: Check assistant documentation and appeal if the adjustment appears incorrect.

title: DRG-based payment adjustment
plain: Payment was adjusted using the diagnosis-related group method. The DRG determines the inpatient payment amount.
action: Verify the DRG assignment and documentation; appeal if the DRG is wrong.

title: Stop-loss adjustment applied
plain: Payment was adjusted under the payer's stop-loss rule, which changes how unusually high-cost claims are paid once charges pass a set threshold — for example, paying a percentage of billed charges instead of the fee schedule amount.
action: Review the stop-loss provision in the fee schedule or contract if the payment is unexpected.

title: Payment based on invoice
plain: Reimbursement was based on the invoice submitted. The invoice amount, rather than a fee schedule, supported the payment.
action: Keep the invoice with the claim records; no action otherwise.

title: Policy not in effect at loss
plain: The policy was not active on the date of loss. Because of that, no coverage is available for this claim.
action: Verify policy status and date of loss; bill the correct payer or patient.

title: No PIP or MedPay coverage
plain: The policy did not include Personal Injury Protection or Medical Payments coverage when the loss happened. That benefit is not available.
action: Confirm auto policy coverage and bill the correct payer or patient.

title: Service before date of loss
plain: The service date is earlier than the reported date of loss. The claim falls outside the loss period for this policy.
action: Confirm the dates and resubmit a corrected claim to the correct payer.

title: Injury date mismatches loss date
plain: The injury date on the claim does not match the reported date of loss. This date mismatch prevents processing as billed.
action: Verify the injury and loss dates and submit a corrected claim.

title: Maximum medical improvement adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted because the patient reached maximum medical improvement (MMI).
action: Review the MMI date and appeal if it is incorrect.

title: Geographic region payment adjustment
plain: The payment amount is based on the provider's geographic region.
action: Verify the locality used and appeal if the region is wrong.

title: Statutory interest payment
plain: The payer is adding interest because the benefits were not paid within the legally required time frame.
action: No action - informational.

title: Appropriate code required for service
plain: The claim needs to be resubmitted using the correct code for the services provided.
action: Correct the code and resubmit the claim.

title: Not considered a medical expense
plain: The billed service is not treated as a medical expense under the plan.
action: Review benefit coverage and bill a covered service or patient responsibility if appropriate.

title: Sales tax exempt item
plain: No sales tax applies to this item.
action: No action - informational.

title: Sales tax included in reimbursement
plain: The reimbursement amount already includes the applicable sales tax.
action: No action - informational.

title: Medical necessity not documented
plain: The documentation does not show that the services were medically necessary.
action: Submit medical records that support necessity or appeal.

title: Final bill needed for payment
plain: Payment will be considered once a final bill is received.
action: Submit the final bill for payment consideration.

title: Agreed amount adjustment
plain: The payment was changed to reflect an amount that the parties agreed upon.
action: Verify the agreement and appeal if the adjustment is incorrect.

title: Legal settlement adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted according to a legal settlement.
action: Review the settlement terms; no action if the adjustment matches.

title: Unlicensed provider not reimbursable
plain: Because the rendering provider does not hold a license, the services cannot be paid.
action: Verify licensure and appeal with proof if the provider is licensed.

title: One E/M per course of care
plain: The plan covers just one evaluation and management (E/M) code at this level for the entire course of care.
action: Bill only one E/M at that level unless a distinct exception applies.

title: Missing prescription for service
plain: A required prescription is missing.
action: Obtain and submit the missing prescription.

title: Incomplete or invalid prescription
plain: The prescription is incomplete or invalid.
action: Obtain a complete, valid prescription and resubmit.

title: Medicare Fee Schedule Adjustment
plain: Payment was adjusted using the Medicare fee schedule.
action: Verify the Medicare fee schedule adjustment if needed.

title: Primary Procedure MPPR Reduction
plain: This procedure is the primary code subject to Medicare's multiple procedure payment reduction rule.
action: Check the MPPR calculation if the payment is questioned.

title: Jurisdiction Cost-Charge Ratio Payment
plain: The payment was based on a cost-to-charge ratio for the jurisdiction.
action: Review the jurisdiction cost-charge ratio if payment is disputed.

title: Health Insurance Offset Applied
plain: The payer applied an amount to a health insurance offset.
action: Review the offset and coordination of benefits details.

title: Outpatient Per Diem Factor Calculation
plain: Reimbursement was calculated from an outpatient per diem, an outpatient factor, a fee schedule amount, or a combination.
action: Verify the outpatient payment methodology used.

title: Pre-Requisite Procedure Not Provided
plain: This service is not covered unless a required earlier procedure or service was provided.
action: Submit documentation that the prerequisite procedure or service was provided.

title: Injured Party Information Needed
plain: More information is needed from the injured party before the claim can proceed.
action: Request and submit the required information from the injured party.

title: Not Payable Under Outpatient Fee Schedule
plain: Payment for this service is not allowed under the outpatient facility fee schedule.
action: Check whether another payment methodology applies.

title: Films/Images Not Returned
plain: The submitted films or images will not be returned.
action: No action - informational.

title: Missing Post-Operative Images/Visual Fields
plain: Post-operative images or visual field results are missing.
action: Submit the missing post-operative images or visual field results.

title: Invalid Post-Operative Images/Visual Fields
plain: The post-operative images or visual field results are incomplete or invalid.
action: Correct and resubmit the post-operative images or visual field results.

title: Invalid Prior Dental Extraction Date
plain: The date of previous dental extractions is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide a complete and valid date of previous dental extractions.

title: Invalid Full Arch Series
plain: The full arch series is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid full arch series.

title: Invalid Prior Periodontal Therapy History
plain: The history of prior periodontal therapy or maintenance is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Provide a complete and valid history of prior periodontal therapy or maintenance.

title: Invalid Prior Treatment Documentation
plain: Prior treatment documentation is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid prior treatment documentation.

title: Specialty Claim Filed as General
plain: The payer treated this as a general claim, but it was supposed to be submitted as a specialty claim. Payment was denied because the claim type did not match the services billed.
action: Verify the claim type and resubmit as a specialty claim if appropriate.

title: Missing, Incomplete, or Invalid Prosthesis Code
plain: The claim did not include a valid prosthesis, crown, or inlay code - it was missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs a correct code before it can process the claim.
action: Submit the correct prosthesis, crown, or inlay code for the service billed.

title: Missing Required Questionnaire
plain: A required questionnaire was not included, was incomplete, or was invalid. The payer needs the completed questionnaire before it can decide payment.
action: Complete and submit the required questionnaire.

title: Retroactive Disenrollment Reversal
plain: The payer reversed this claim because the patient's enrollment was taken back retroactively. This usually means coverage did not exist for the date of service after the disenrollment.
action: Verify eligibility for the date of service and rebill or bill the patient as appropriate.

title: Medical Review Reversal
plain: The payer reversed the claim after a medical or utilization review decision. The review outcome changed whether the service is payable.
action: Review the payer's determination and appeal with supporting clinical documentation if warranted.

title: Retroactive Rate Change Reversal
plain: The payer reversed the claim because the allowed rate was changed retroactively. The reimbursement is being recalculated under the revised rate.
action: Review the updated rate and adjust the expected reimbursement.

title: Provider Appeal Reversal
plain: The payer reversed the original claim because the provider submitted an appeal. The claim will be readjudicated as part of the appeal process.
action: No action needed on the reversal; monitor for the readjudicated claim from the appeal.

title: Patient Appeal Reversal
plain: The payer reversed the original claim because the patient submitted an appeal. The claim will be readjudicated as part of the appeal process.
action: No action needed on the reversal; monitor for the readjudicated claim from the appeal.

title: Incorrect Initial Rate Reversal
plain: The initial adjudication used an incorrect rate, so the payer reversed the claim to fix it. The new payment should reflect the corrected rate.
action: Review the corrected payment and update the account if needed.

title: Provider Claim Cancellation Reversal
plain: The provider canceled the claim, so the payer reversed it. This is an informational notice about the cancellation.
action: No action - informational; confirm the cancellation was intended.

title: Provider Claim Resubmission Reversal
plain: The provider resubmitted or changed the claim, causing the original claim to be reversed. The replacement claim should be processed separately.
action: No action - informational; monitor the replacement claim.

title: Incorrect Patient Responsibility Reversal
plain: The original claim had incorrect patient financial responsibility information. The payer reversed it to correct the patient's share.
action: Review the corrected patient responsibility and update the patient ledger.

title: COB TPL Recovery Reversal
plain: A Coordination of Benefits or third party liability recovery changed the claim retroactively. The payer reversed it to apply the other coverage or recovery.
action: Review the COB or TPL update and bill the correct payer or patient as applicable.

title: Contract Incentive Program Reversal
plain: The payer made a retroactive adjustment under a contract incentive program. The reversal reflects the incentive program's rate change.
action: No action - informational; apply the revised incentive adjustment to the account.

title: Premium Nonpayment Coverage Loss Reversal
plain: The patient lost coverage because health insurance premiums were not paid by the end of the grace period. The payer reversed the claim because coverage was no longer active.
action: Verify the coverage termination date and bill the patient or another payer for the date of service if coverage was inactive.

title: PQRS Incentive Program Adjustment
plain: Payment was adjusted under the Physician Quality Reporting System (PQRS), a Medicare program that ties reimbursement to the provider's reporting of clinical quality measures.
action: Verify PQRS reporting compliance for future claims.

title: EHR Incentive Program Adjustment
plain: Payment was adjusted under the Electronic Health Records (EHR) Incentive Program, which ties reimbursement to the provider's adoption and meaningful use of certified EHR technology.
action: Check EHR incentive program reporting and eligibility.

title: Value-based Payment Modifier Adjustment
plain: Payment was increased or reduced under the Value-based Payment Modifier, a Medicare program that adjusts physician reimbursement based on the quality and cost of care delivered relative to peers.
action: Review value-based performance data and modifier calculations.

title: Review of Previous Claims Decision
plain: This decision was made after comparing the claim to your other claims—already adjudicated or still in process—for the same or similar services, typically to identify duplicates or overlaps.
action: Review prior claims to avoid duplicate or conflicting billing.

title: Service Incompatible with Prior Claims
plain: This service cannot be paid alongside a service on another claim that was already processed or is currently in process, because the two are considered incompatible.
action: Review prior claims for conflicts and adjust coding if appropriate.

title: No Appeal, Resubmit with Corrections
plain: This decision cannot be appealed. However, if the claim contained errors, you may correct the information and submit the claim again.
action: Correct the claim information and resubmit; do not file an appeal, as appeals are not permitted for this decision.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Documentation
plain: The documentation submitted was incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid documentation.

title: Missing Documentation
plain: Required documentation was missing.
action: Provide the missing documentation.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Orders
plain: The orders submitted were incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid orders.

title: Missing Orders
plain: Required orders were missing.
action: Provide the missing orders.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Notes
plain: The notes submitted were incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid notes.

title: Missing Notes
plain: Required notes were missing.
action: Provide the missing notes.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Summary
plain: The summary submitted was incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid summary.

title: Missing Summary
plain: Required summary was missing.
action: Provide the missing summary.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Report
plain: The report submitted was incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid report.

title: Required report is missing
plain: The payer did not receive a report it requires.
action: Submit the missing report to the payer.

title: Incomplete or invalid chart
plain: The chart sent to the payer is incomplete or invalid.
action: Send a complete, valid chart.

title: Missing chart documentation
plain: The payer did not receive the required chart.
action: Submit the missing chart.

title: Invalid face-to-face exam documentation
plain: The documentation of the face-to-face examination is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete and valid face-to-face exam documentation.

title: Missing face-to-face exam documentation
plain: The payer did not receive documentation of the face-to-face examination.
action: Submit the missing face-to-face exam documentation.

title: Plan requirements penalty applied
plain: A penalty was applied because plan requirements were not met.
action: Review the plan requirements and appeal or correct the issue if appropriate.

title: Patient overpayment refund needed
plain: The patient paid more than the patient responsibility shown on this notice. You may need to refund the difference.
action: Compare the patient payment with patient responsibility and refund any overpayment.

title: Coverage only in clinical trial
plain: The plan covers this service solely when it is delivered as part of a clinical trial.
action: Verify clinical trial participation and submit supporting documentation, or confirm coverage status.

title: Workers' comp set-aside funds required
plain: The patient must pay for this service or item using Workers' Compensation Set-Aside funds.
action: Ensure the service is billed to and paid from the patient's WCSA funds as required.

title: Liability set-aside funds required
plain: The patient must pay for this service or item using Liability Set-Aside funds.
action: Ensure the service is billed to and paid from the patient's LSA funds as required.

title: No-fault set-aside funds required
plain: The patient must pay for this service or item using No-Fault Set-Aside funds.
action: Ensure the service is billed to and paid from the patient's NFSA funds as required.

title: Liability insurer reports ongoing responsibility
plain: A liability insurer has reported that it has ongoing responsibility for medical services for this diagnosis.
action: Bill the liability insurer as the primary payer for services related to this diagnosis.

title: Conditional payment not allowed
plain: A conditional payment is not allowed for this claim.
action: Review coordination of benefits and bill the correct primary payer.

title: No-fault insurer reports ongoing responsibility
plain: A no-fault insurer has reported that it has ongoing responsibility for medical services for this diagnosis.
action: Bill the no-fault insurer as the primary payer for services related to this diagnosis.

title: Workers' comp insurer reports ongoing responsibility
plain: A workers' compensation insurer has reported that it has ongoing responsibility for medical services for this diagnosis.
action: Bill the workers' compensation insurer as the primary payer for services related to this diagnosis.

title: Missing patient medical/dental record
plain: The payer did not receive the patient's medical or dental record required for this service.
action: Submit the missing patient medical or dental record.

title: Incomplete or invalid patient record
plain: The patient's medical or dental record for this service is incomplete or not valid.
action: Correct and resubmit a complete, valid patient record.

title: Incomplete or invalid mental health assessment
plain: The mental health assessment submitted for this service is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid mental health assessment.

title: Unlicensed facility services not covered
plain: The payer will not reimburse services performed at a facility that is not licensed.
action: Verify the facility is properly licensed and submit proof or correct the billing if possible.

title: Regulatory surcharges paid to state
plain: Any regulatory surcharge tied to this service is sent straight to the state, so it is not included in the payment the provider receives from this payer.
action: No action — informational.

title: Eligibility limited to inability to work or perform normal activities
plain: The patient qualifies for these medical services only if an illness or injury prevents them from working or doing normal activities.
action: Submit documentation showing the patient meets the work or activity limitation.

title: Incomplete or invalid sleep study report
plain: The sleep study report submitted for this service is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid sleep study report.

title: Missing sleep study report
plain: The payer did not receive the sleep study report required for this service.
action: Submit the missing sleep study report.

title: Incomplete or invalid vein study report
plain: The vein study report submitted for this service is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid vein study report.

title: Missing vein study report
plain: The payer did not receive the vein study report required for this service.
action: Submit the missing vein study report.

title: Insufficient consumer spending account funds
plain: The patient's consumer spending account does not have enough funds to cover their liability for this claim or service.
action: Collect the patient liability through another method or advise the patient of the balance.

title: Site-neutral payment applied
plain: The payment was set under a site-neutral policy, meaning the amount does not vary based on where the service was performed.
action: No action — informational; review the contract if the payment appears incorrect.

title: May be work-related accident
plain: The payer adjusted the claim because the treatment appears to stem from a workplace accident, which is usually the responsibility of workers' compensation rather than this plan.
action: Verify whether this is workers' compensation and bill the correct payer with supporting documentation.

title: May be auto/other accident related
plain: The payer adjusted the claim because the treatment appears to stem from an auto or other accident, and another insurer may be responsible for payment.
action: Determine accident-related liability and bill the correct auto or other insurer if applicable.

title: Missing ambulance report
plain: The payer did not receive the ambulance report required for this service.
action: Submit the missing ambulance report.

title: Ambulance report incomplete or invalid
plain: The ambulance report submitted is not complete or valid. The payer needs a proper report to process the ambulance service.
action: Submit a complete and valid ambulance report.

title: Claim sent to wrong payer
plain: The claim was filed with a payer or plan that is not responsible for it. It should be sent to the payer or plan for the patient's residence.
action: Submit the claim to the patient's resident payer or plan.

title: Related hospital charges not received
plain: Payment was adjusted because the related hospital charges were not on file. The claim may need the hospital charges submitted before it can be processed.
action: Ensure the related hospital charges are submitted.

title: Missing blood gas report
plain: A blood gas report is needed but was not provided. The payer cannot process the claim without it.
action: Submit the missing blood gas report.

title: Incomplete or invalid blood gas report
plain: The blood gas report is incomplete or invalid. A complete and valid report is needed for review.
action: Submit a complete and valid blood gas report.

title: Patient covered under Medicare Part D
plain: Payment was adjusted because the patient has Medicare Part D coverage. The service may need to be billed to the Part D plan.
action: Bill the Medicare Part D plan as appropriate.

title: Missing or invalid HIPPS TAC
plain: The HIPPS Treatment Authorization Code is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The payer needs a valid TAC to process the claim.
action: Obtain and submit a valid HIPPS TAC.

title: Missing attachment control number
plain: The Attachment Control Number is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The claim cannot be matched to the attachment without it.
action: Provide or correct the attachment control number.

title: Missing referring provider qualifier
plain: The 1500 claim form is missing a valid qualifier for the referring provider or other source. This qualifier tells the payer the role of the provider listed (for example, referring, ordering, or supervising).
action: Add or correct the referring provider qualifier on the claim.

title: Missing or invalid ICD indicator
plain: The ICD indicator on the claim is missing, incomplete, or invalid. This indicator tells the payer which ICD code set is being used.
action: Enter a valid ICD indicator and resubmit.

title: Missing drop-off address
plain: The point-of-drop-off address is missing, incomplete, or invalid. The claim needs the correct address to process the transport service.
action: Provide a complete and valid drop-off address.

title: Federal Indian Fees schedule adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted according to the Federal Indian Fees schedule (MLR). This is a pricing adjustment based on that fee schedule.
action: No action — informational.

title: Prior authorization decision adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted based on the prior authorization decision. The payer applied the authorization outcome to the claim.
action: Review the prior authorization decision and appeal if it is incorrect.

title: NEMA XR-29 payment adjustment
plain: The payment was adjusted using NEMA Standard XR-29-2013, which sets dose-management requirements for CT equipment. Payment may be reduced when the imaging equipment does not meet this standard.
action: Confirm XR-29 compliance and appeal if the adjustment is wrong.

title: Facility not authorized for payment
plain: The facility is not authorized to be paid for these services. Payment cannot be made to this facility as billed.
action: Verify facility enrollment or authorization and correct the billing entity.

title: Provider Not Authorized for Payment
plain: The payer says this provider is not authorized to be paid for the listed service(s).
action: Verify enrollment, credentialing, and contract status with the payer; appeal if the denial is incorrect.

title: Facility Not Certified for 3-D Mammography
plain: The facility is not certified to perform tomosynthesis (3-D) mammography for this payer.
action: Confirm certification or bill under a certified facility or code as appropriate.

title: Demonstration Code Not Appropriate
plain: A demonstration code on the claim is not valid for this situation.
action: Remove the demonstration code and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing or Invalid Hematocrit Value
plain: The claim is missing a valid hematocrit (HCT) value, or the value submitted is incomplete or invalid.
action: Obtain and submit a complete, valid HCT value.

title: Prior Payer Coinsurance Not Covered
plain: This payer will not cover coinsurance that a previous payer assessed.
action: Verify coordination of benefits and bill the balance according to plan rules.

title: Prior Payer Copayment Not Covered
plain: This payer will not cover a copayment that a previous payer assessed.
action: Verify coordination of benefits and bill the balance according to plan rules.

title: Medicaid State Enrollment Required First
plain: The member's Medicaid state requires the provider to be enrolled there before it will process claim benefits.
action: Enroll in the member's Medicaid state program, then resubmit the claim.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Initial Evaluation
plain: The initial evaluation report is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid initial evaluation report.

title: Lateral Diagnosis Required
plain: The claim requires a diagnosis code that specifies laterality — which side of the body (left or right) is affected.
action: Add or update the diagnosis code to one that indicates left or right side, then resubmit.

title: Provider Adjustment Request Processed
plain: The payer processed the adjustment request and adjusted the original claim using the information received.
action: No action — informational.

title: Federal Limiting Charge Applies
plain: Federal law limits the maximum amount you can charge for this service to the limiting charge.
action: Adjust the charge to the limiting charge and do not bill the patient above it.

title: Rebill Urgent and Ancillary Separately
plain: Urgent or emergent services and ancillary services should be billed separately.
action: Split the services and rebill urgent/emergent and ancillary services separately.

title: Drug Not from Specialty Vendor
plain: The drug supplied was not obtained from a specialty vendor, which may violate payer requirements.
action: Verify the specialty-vendor requirement and source the drug from an approved vendor.

title: Review Third Party Processor Agreement
plain: Fees for this payment type are described in your Third Party Processor Agreement.
action: Review the Third Party Processor Agreement for fee details.

title: Payment Adjusted for Film Radiograph
plain: The payment was adjusted because the x-ray radiograph was submitted on film.
action: Verify the imaging type billed and resubmit if digital was performed.

title: Telehealth Service Not Covered
plain: The payer does not cover this service when provided as telehealth. Check the plan's telehealth coverage before billing.
action: Verify telehealth coverage and adjust billing as appropriate.

title: Missing Assignment of Benefits Indicator
plain: The claim did not include the assignment of benefits indicator. That indicator is needed for claim processing.
action: Add the assignment of benefits indicator and resubmit the claim.

title: Missing Primary Care Physician Information
plain: The claim is missing the patient's primary care physician information. Add the required PCP details.
action: Provide the patient's primary care physician information and resubmit.

title: Replacement/Void Claim Too Early
plain: A replacement or void claim cannot be processed until the original claim has finalized. Wait for payment or denial on the original claim before resubmitting.
action: Wait until the original claim finalizes, then resubmit the replacement or void claim.

title: Missing or Invalid End Therapy Date
plain: The claim lacks an acceptable date for when therapy ended. The date may be absent, partially entered, or formatted incorrectly.
action: Add or correct the therapy end date and resubmit the claim.

title: QMB Wrongful Deductible Alert
plain: The patient is a Medicaid or Qualified Medicare Beneficiary. Deductibles should not be collected from this patient; review records for any wrongful collection.
action: Refund or adjust any wrongfully collected deductible and bill a subsequent payer if applicable.

title: QMB Wrongful Coinsurance Alert
plain: The patient is a Medicaid or Qualified Medicare Beneficiary. Coinsurance should not be collected from this patient; review records for any wrongful collection.
