action: Refund or adjust any wrongfully collected coinsurance and bill a subsequent payer if applicable.

title: QMB Wrongful Copayment Alert
plain: The patient is a Medicaid or Qualified Medicare Beneficiary. Copayments should not be collected from this patient; review records for any wrongful collection.
action: Refund or adjust any wrongfully collected copayment and bill a subsequent payer if applicable.

title: Missing Comprehensive Procedure Code
plain: The claim is missing a comprehensive procedure code. Submit the full procedure code.
action: Add the comprehensive procedure code and resubmit.

title: Missing Current Radiology Images
plain: Current radiology films or images are missing. Provide the required current imaging.
action: Provide the current radiology films or images with the claim or appeal.

title: Orthodontic Benefit Limitation
plain: The plan has a benefit limitation for the active or retention phase of orthodontic treatment. Check the orthodontic benefit before billing.
action: Review orthodontic benefit limitations and bill the patient for non-covered phases as appropriate.

title: PHP Minimum Hours Requirement
plain: For an eligible Partial Hospitalization Program patient, the plan of care must show at least 20 hours of PHP services per week. PHP services must follow the plan of care.
action: Ensure the plan of care documents the required 20 hours per week and provide documentation if resubmitting.

title: TPA Missing Required Information
plain: The third-party administrator or review organization did not receive the required information. Send the information they requested.
action: Send the required information to the third-party administrator or review organization.

title: Clinical Trial Not Covered
plain: The plan does not pay for services related to a clinical trial. Confirm whether any portion of the care is covered outside the trial before billing.
action: Verify coverage and bill the patient or another payer for non-covered clinical trial services as appropriate.

title: Provider Not Accredited for Service
plain: The provider or supplier is not accredited for this product or service. Do not bill this service unless the accreditation requirement is met.
action: Verify accreditation or obtain the required accreditation before billing this service.

title: Missing history and physical report
plain: The payer did not receive the history and physical report it expected for this claim.
action: Submit the missing history and physical report.

title: Invalid or incomplete history and physical report
plain: The history and physical report was submitted, but the payer found it incomplete or invalid.
action: Review the report, complete or correct it, and resubmit.

title: Payment adjusted for technology type
plain: The payment amount was changed because of the type of technology used for the service.
action: Review the technology billed and correct it if the adjustment is wrong.

title: Resubmit item as a purchase
plain: The item on this claim needs to be submitted again and billed as a purchase.
action: Resubmit the item as a purchase.

title: Missing or invalid hemoglobin value
plain: The claim is missing a hemoglobin (Hgb) lab result, or the value provided is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit a complete, valid hemoglobin (Hgb) value.

title: Missing or invalid date qualifier
plain: A 'date qualifier' is the code that tells the payer what a date on the claim refers to (for example, an admission date). That code is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Add or correct the date qualifier and resubmit.

title: Void original and resubmit claim
plain: The payer wants the original claim voided and a new claim sent in its place.
action: Send a void request for the original claim, then resubmit a new claim.

title: Individual identifier required, not a group identifier
plain: The claim was sent with a group identifier, but the payer requires the identifier of the individual provider for this submission.
action: Resubmit with the individual provider's identifier instead of the group's.

title: One service date per claim
plain: Each claim may contain services for only one date of service, and this claim includes more than one.
action: Split the services so each claim has only one service date.

title: Tribal Group Health Plan services
plain: Informational note: this service was performed at a facility that participates in Medicare, or at a critical access hospital (CAH), and is covered under a self-insured tribal group health plan as provided by federal regulation 42 CFR 136.
action: No action — informational.

title: Claim outside payer service area
plain: This payer says the claim is outside its service area. The claim should be filed with the payer or plan for the area where the rendering physician is located.
action: File the claim with the payer or plan in the rendering physician's service area.

title: Contracted group must submit claim
plain: For this service, the contracted medical group or hospital is responsible for submitting the claim.
action: Have the contracted medical group or hospital submit the claim.

title: Outpatient Code Editor alert
plain: The payer routed this claim through its Outpatient Code Editor.
action: No action — informational.

title: Correct Code Editor alert
plain: The payer processed this claim through its Correct Code Editor.
action: No action — informational.

title: Included in global transplant allowance
plain: This service will not be paid separately because it is already covered by the all-inclusive (global) payment the payer makes for a transplant.
action: Do not bill this service separately; it is included in the global transplant allowance.

title: MIPS Payment Adjustment
plain: This payment was adjusted based on the Merit-based Incentive Payment System (MIPS).
action: No action — informational.

title: Not Covered for Provider Type
plain: This service is not covered when billed by this provider type or provider specialty.
action: Verify coverage for the rendering provider type or specialty before rebilling.

title: Competitive Bidding Fee Schedule Adjustment
plain: The allowed fee schedule amount for this service was adjusted using prior competitive bidding rates. Contact your local contractor for details.
action: Contact the local contractor for more information.

title: Disaster Declaration In-Network Benefit Processing
plain: Due to a federal, state, or local disaster declaration, this claim was processed as in-network. When the disaster declaration ends, normal network payment rules will apply again.
action: No action — informational.

title: Missing Sequestration Reduction from Prior Payer
plain: The prior payer's payment is missing the required federal sequestration reduction.
action: Verify the prior payer's remittance and request a corrected explanation if needed.

title: Service Date Span Exceeds 18 Months
plain: The claim's start service date and end service date cover more than 18 months.
action: Split the claim so the service date span is 18 months or less.

title: Missing or Invalid NDC Unit Count
plain: The NDC unit count is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct NDC unit count.

title: Missing or Invalid NDC Unit Measure
plain: The NDC unit of measure is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct NDC unit of measure.

title: Lab Private Payor Reporting Alert
plain: This alert reminds applicable laboratories that they must collect and report private payor data to CMS from January 1, 2020 through March 31, 2020.
action: If applicable, ensure required private payor data is reported to CMS.

title: Dates Do Not Match EVV
plain: The claim's dates of service do not match the dates in the Electronic Visit Verification System.
action: Verify EVV records and correct the claim dates if needed.

title: Patient Not Enrolled in EVV
plain: The patient is not enrolled in the Electronic Visit Verification System.
action: Confirm EVV enrollment or correct the patient's EVV status.

title: EVV Units Do Not Meet Requirements
plain: The units in the Electronic Visit Verification System do not meet the requirements for the visit.
action: Review EVV visit details and submit units that meet requirements.

title: EVV Visit Not Found
plain: The Electronic Visit Verification System does not have a matching visit for this claim.
action: Verify the EVV visit was submitted and linked to the claim.

title: Missing Procedure Modifier
plain: A required procedure modifier is missing from the claim.
action: Add the required procedure modifier and resubmit.

title: Invalid Procedure Modifier
plain: The procedure modifier submitted is incomplete or invalid.
action: Correct the procedure modifier and resubmit.

title: EVV data submission required
plain: EVV data for this claim must be sent through the required EVV vendor. Submit the EVV record through that vendor.
action: Submit EVV data through the required EVV vendor.

title: Early intervention guidelines not met
plain: The claim did not satisfy the guidelines for early intervention services. Review the criteria and documentation, then appeal if the service qualifies.
action: Review early intervention criteria and appeal if guidelines are met.

title: MSSP inclusion criteria not met
plain: The patient did not meet the eligibility criteria for inclusion in the Medicare Shared Savings Program. Check attribution or eligibility and bill outside the MSSP if appropriate.
action: Verify MSSP attribution or eligibility and bill accordingly.

title: Missing or invalid FIPS code
plain: The FIPS code on the claim is absent, incomplete, or invalid. Submit the correct FIPS code.
action: Submit a valid FIPS code.

title: Payment suppressed by contracted funding
plain: Payment is being held because of a contracted funding arrangement. Confirm the funding status and contact the payer if payment is expected.
action: Confirm contracted funding status and contact the payer if payment is expected.

title: Missing or invalid Z-Code identifier
plain: The Diagnostics Exchange Z-Code identifier is missing, incomplete, or invalid. Provide a valid Z-Code.
action: Submit a valid Diagnostics Exchange Z-Code identifier.

title: Balance billing rules applied
plain: This service was processed under federal or state no-surprise and balance-billing rules. Amounts marked OA, CO, or PI cannot be collected from the patient; they become provider liability or may be billed to a subsequent payer. Any amount collected above the PR amount must be refunded to the patient within the applicable federal/state timeframe.
action: Do not collect OA, CO, or PI amounts from the patient; refund any overpayment above PR within required timeframes, and bill the next payer or dispute via the appeal process if appropriate.

title: Provider revalidation not completed
plain: The payer has not received your response to provider or supplier enrollment revalidation requests. Complete and send the requested revalidation information.
action: Respond to the provider or supplier revalidation request.

title: Duplicate occurrence or span code
plain: The claim contains a duplicate occurrence code or occurrence span code. Remove or correct the duplicate and resubmit.
action: Remove or correct the duplicate code and resubmit the claim.

title: Patient cost share waived
plain: The patient's cost-sharing amount for this service has been waived. Do not collect that amount from the patient.
action: Do not collect the waived patient share and adjust the account.

title: Jurisdiction exempt from sales tax
plain: Sales and health tax charges do not apply in this claim's jurisdiction, so no such taxes were assessed.
action: No action — informational.

title: Unrelated service reduced; patient balance
plain: The payer reduced payment for a service, procedure, or treatment considered unrelated. The remaining balance is the patient's responsibility.
action: Bill the patient for the balance, or appeal if the service was related.

title: Provider W-9 or registration missing
plain: The payer does not have your W-9 or payee registration on file. Send the required form to complete payment setup.
action: Submit the W-9 or payee registration to the payer.

title: Missing modifier added
plain: The payer added a missing modifier to process the claim. Check that the added modifier is correct and appeal if it is not.
action: Confirm the added modifier is correct; appeal if it is not.

title: Service postponed by disaster mandate
plain: The service or procedure was postponed because of an official mandate or disaster declaration. Deductible and member liability amounts will be applied to the prior plan year in which the cancelled procedure was originally scheduled.
action: Verify prior plan year application and adjust billing if needed.

title: Procedure Code Changed for Service Level
plain: The payer added or changed the procedure code because the level of service billed goes beyond the condition(s) accepted as compensable on this claim.
action: Review the accepted/compensable condition(s) and supporting documentation; adjust the coding or appeal if the service level was appropriate.

title: Workers' Comp Claim Filed in Different State
plain: A workers' compensation claim was submitted to a state other than the correct one.
action: Refile the claim with the correct state workers' compensation payer or agency.

title: North Dakota Administrative Rule Alert
plain: This is an informational alert about North Dakota Administrative Rule 92-01-02-50.3. It does not by itself describe a specific payment adjustment.
action: Review the North Dakota rule if it applies to this claim.

title: Patient Cannot Be Billed Alert
plain: This alert means the patient must not be billed for the charges on the claim.
action: Do not bill the patient for these charges.

title: Missing or Invalid CBSA Code
plain: The claim is missing a valid Core-Based Statistical Area (CBSA) code — the geographic (metro/micropolitan) area code tied to the service location that the payer uses for pricing.
action: Correct or add the CBSA code and resubmit the claim.

title: Nebraska Out-of-Network Emergency Claim Processed
plain: This claim, or part of it, was processed under Nebraska's Out of Network Emergency Medical Care Act, LB997, dated July 24, 2020.
action: No action — informational.

title: Nebraska Out-of-Network Emergency Act Alert
plain: This is an alert that Nebraska's Out of Network Emergency Medical Care Act, LB997, dated July 24, 2020, may apply.
action: Review the Nebraska act for any impact on this claim.

title: NDC Does Not Match Billed Code
plain: The National Drug Code (NDC) on the claim identifies a different drug than the HCPCS/CPT procedure code billed, so the two do not line up.
action: Correct the NDC or the HCPCS/CPT code so they match, then resubmit.

title: Billed NDC Is Obsolete
plain: The National Drug Code billed is no longer valid or current.
action: Replace the obsolete NDC with a current valid NDC and resubmit.

title: NDC Cannot Be Associated With Product
plain: The payer could not match the billed National Drug Code (NDC) to any known drug product, so the drug cannot be identified or priced.
action: Verify the NDC and product, correct if needed, and resubmit.

title: Missing Tooth Prior to Coverage
plain: The dental missing tooth clause applies because the tooth was missing before the member's effective date.
action: Verify the tooth history; if correct, the service may not be covered.

title: Missing Service or Treatment Narrative
plain: The claim lacks a complete or valid narrative describing the service or treatment.
action: Submit a complete narrative description and resubmit the claim.

title: Payment Reduced for Therapy Assistant
plain: Payment was reduced because a therapy assistant, rather than a qualifying therapist, furnished the services.
action: Verify the assistant's credentials and supervision; no change if billing is correct.

title: Pay-to and Rendering TINs Mismatch
plain: The tax identification number for the pay-to provider does not match the rendering provider's TIN.
action: Correct the TINs so they match and resubmit the claim.

title: Modalities Exceed Maximum Per Session
plain: The number of therapy modalities performed in one session is more than the payer's acceptable maximum.
action: Review documentation and bill only the allowed number, or appeal with supporting records.

title: Exhaust Primary Insurance Appeals
plain: Your primary other health insurance denied coverage. Before this payer can review the claim for reimbursement, you must complete all appeal levels with that primary plan.
action: Finish all primary OHI appeals and document exhaustion.

title: ERISA Jurisdiction Applies
plain: This coverage falls under ERISA's exclusive federal jurisdiction, which affects benefit and appeal rules.
action: No action — informational.

title: ERISA Jurisdiction Does Not Apply
plain: This coverage is not under ERISA's exclusive federal jurisdiction, so other laws or rules may govern it.
action: No action — informational.

title: Refund Collected Copayment
plain: This claim was adjusted or reversed. Any copayment collected from the member must be returned.
action: Refund the collected copayment to the member.

title: State OON Emergency Rules Applied
plain: A state Out-of-Network Medical Emergency Care Act was applied to this claim. The payment can be disputed through the state's appeal, grievance, or arbitration process.
action: Use the state dispute process if disputing payment.

title: Federal No Surprise Billing Applied
plain: The federal No Surprise Billing Act was applied to this claim. Payment disputes should follow the applicable federal appeal, grievance, or dispute resolution process.
action: Use the federal dispute process if disputing payment.

title: QPA Used for Cost Share
plain: The federal No Surprises Act Qualified Payment Amount was used to calculate the member's cost share.
action: No action — informational.

title: Patient Liability Mismatch
plain: The patient liability or share of cost submitted does not match the amount the payer has on record for this member.
action: Reconcile patient liability with the payer's records.

title: Cost Share NSA Compliant
plain: The member's cost share complies with the No Surprises Act and was calculated using the lower of the Qualified Payment Amount or the billed charge.
action: No action — informational.

title: NSA All-Payer Rate Applied
plain: This No Surprises Act claim was paid at the final out-of-network rate, calculated under an All Payer Model Agreement.
action: No action — informational.

title: NSA Emergency Services Apply
plain: This claim is covered by No Surprises Act rules for emergency services.
action: No action — informational.

title: NSA Nonparticipating Facility Services
plain: This claim is covered by No Surprises Act rules for nonemergency services from an out-of-network provider during a visit to an in-network facility.
action: No action — informational.

title: NSA Air Ambulance Services
plain: This claim is covered by No Surprises Act rules for air ambulance services from a nonparticipating provider.
action: No action — informational.

title: State Law Cost Sharing
plain: The member's cost sharing was calculated under a specified state law as permitted by the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: All-Payer Cost Sharing Applied
plain: The member's cost sharing was calculated using an All-Payer Model Agreement under the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Cost sharing based on QPA
plain: The patient's share was calculated using the qualifying payment amount, as required by the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Cost sharing used billed amount
plain: Because the billed charge was lower than the qualifying payment amount, cost sharing was based on the billed amount under the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Initial payment based on state law
plain: This first payment was calculated under a specified state law, consistent with the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Final payment based on state law
plain: The final payment was calculated under a specified state law, in line with the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Final payment under All-Payer Model
plain: The final payment was based on an All-Payer Model Agreement, as allowed by the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Final payment from open negotiation
plain: The final payment reflects the result of open negotiation under the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Final payment set by IDR
plain: The final payment matches the out-of-network rate selected by a Federal Independent Dispute Resolution Entity under the No Surprises Act.
action: No action — informational.

title: Payment denied on covered service
plain: The service is covered by the plan, but this is a No Surprises Act notice denying payment. The provider may start open negotiation to seek a higher out-of-network rate than the patient's cost-sharing amount.
action: Consider initiating open negotiation if seeking a higher out-of-network rate.

title: Initial NSA payment notice
plain: This initial payment is made under the No Surprises Act, and the provider may begin open negotiation if it wants a higher out-of-network rate.
action: Consider open negotiation if pursuing a higher out-of-network rate.

title: Invalid notice consent no balance billing
plain: The provider said notice and consent were obtained, but they were not consistent with federal law. Cost sharing and total payment were set under the No Surprises Act, and balance billing is not allowed.
action: Do not balance bill; check that notice and consent comply with federal rules.

title: Consent not allowed no balance billing
plain: The patient's notice and consent to balance billing and out-of-network cost sharing is not permitted for these services. Cost sharing and total payment follow the No Surprises Act, and balance billing is prohibited.
action: Do not balance bill; verify the service is eligible for consent.

title: Original claim closed for data change
plain: The original claim was closed because submitted data changed, and the adjustment claim will be handled under a new claim number.
action: Track the new claim number for processing.

title: HCBS patient responsibility
plain: This charge is the patient's responsibility — a client obligation for Home and Community Based Services (HCBS).
action: Assign or bill the amount to the patient per plan rules.

title: Payment based on plan allowance
plain: The out-of-network payment and cost sharing used the plan's allowance because the provider or facility got the patient's consent to waive No Surprises Act balance billing protections.
action: Confirm the waiver is valid and documented.

title: Processed according to state law
plain: This claim was processed under applicable state law.
action: No action — informational.

title: No Surprises Act may apply
plain: The payer is warning that the No Surprises Act might apply to this claim. It wants you to contact it for instructions on how to send information about whether the item or service was provided during a visit to a participating facility.
action: Contact the payer for instructions on submitting the facility-visit information.

title: No Surprises Act disagreement
plain: The payer did not process this claim under No Surprises Act cost-sharing or out-of-network payment rules and disagrees that those rules apply. You can ask the payer for its reason and appeal the decision for the patient through internal and external review.
action: Ask the payer why it disagrees; if appropriate, appeal on the patient's behalf.

title: Additional information requested
plain: A Health Care Claim Request for Additional Information, also called a 277 RFAI, was sent for this claim.
action: Review the request and send the additional information requested.

title: Medicare Advantage appeal rights
plain: If you are a non-participating Medicare Advantage provider, you can appeal when the plan denies payment in part or in full or does not pay at the expected Medicare rate or service level. Written appeals must be filed within 60 days of the remittance advice, and the plan needs a signed Waiver of Liability Statement; it will decide within 60 days after receiving the completed forms.
action: If appealing, submit a written appeal and signed Waiver of Liability within 60 days.

title: Electronic additional information request
plain: The payer sent an electronic request for more information about this claim.
action: Review and respond to the electronic request for additional information.

title: Real-time claim processed
plain: This claim was first processed in real time, and the payer sent a real-time 835 response.
action: No action — informational.

title: EVV data requirements not met
plain: The claim did not include the Electronic Visit Verification data elements that are required.
action: Correct the EVV data and resubmit the claim.

title: Primary paid maximum allowed
plain: The primary insurer paid the maximum allowed amount for this service or procedure, so there is no remaining payment due from this payer.
action: No action — informational.

title: Invalid delay reason code
plain: The payer did not accept the Delay Reason Code on this claim — the code used to explain why submission was delayed — because the situation does not meet the criteria for using that code.
action: Review the delay reason code, correct it or supply a supported delay reason, and resubmit the claim.

title: Child medical evaluation missing
plain: The child medical evaluation form or checklist is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid child medical evaluation form or checklist.

title: Payment subject to recoupment
plain: The payer is making these payments but reserves the right to take back all or part of them. This can happen because of litigation outcomes, new or changed state, federal, or regulatory guidance, or other actions affecting the payer's payment obligation.
action: No action — informational; monitor for any future recoupment or guidance.

title: Specialty drug negotiated rate
plain: This claim was processed using a negotiated fee schedule for a specialty drug program.
action: No action — informational; verify the allowed amount if needed.

title: Trauma activation sheet missing
plain: The trauma activation sheet is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid trauma activation sheet.

title: Proof of member payment missing
plain: Proof that the member paid is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit valid proof of the member's payment.

title: RUG code missing or invalid
plain: The Resource Utilization Group code or codes are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit the correct and complete RUG code(s).

title: Missing Initial Evaluation Report
plain: The payer says the initial evaluation report was not submitted with the claim. This documentation is needed before the claim can be processed.
action: Submit the missing initial evaluation report to the payer.

title: Missing Therapy Notes or Report
plain: The payer did not receive the required therapy notes or report. The claim is missing documentation needed to support the services.
action: Submit the required therapy notes or report.

title: Incomplete or Invalid Therapy Notes
plain: The therapy notes or report were received but are incomplete or invalid. The payer cannot process the claim with the documentation as submitted.
action: Review the therapy notes or report and send a complete, valid version.

title: Missing Health Risk Assessment
plain: The health risk assessment is missing from the claim or documentation. The payer needs it to process the claim.
action: Send the missing health risk assessment.

title: Incomplete or Invalid HRA
plain: The health risk assessment was submitted but is incomplete or invalid. The payer cannot accept it as documentation for this claim.
action: Correct the HRA and resubmit it.

title: Transportation Vendor Responsible for Claim
plain: The transportation vendor, not this payer, is responsible for the claim. Payment should come from that vendor.
action: Bill the transportation vendor for this service.

title: Medicare Opt-Out; No Payment
plain: Medicare records show the provider opted out and agreed not to bill Medicare for these services. Medicare cannot pay this claim, and the patient is not responsible for payment.
action: Do not bill the patient; follow the opt-out agreement.

title: Not Covered Under Age 45
plain: This service is only covered for patients age 45 and older. The claim does not qualify because the patient is under that age limit.
action: Confirm the patient's age and verify coverage rules before resubmitting.

title: No Refund; 340B Ceiling Price
plain: No refund is due because this drug was purchased under the 340B Drug Pricing Program at a ceiling price that is already below the manufacturer's maximum fair price.
action: No action — informational.

title: No Refund; Purchased at MFP
plain: No refund is due because the drug was prospectively purchased at the maximum fair price. The purchase price already reflects the applicable price.
action: No action — informational.

title: Refund Uses Different Calculation Method
plain: The refund for this claim was figured using a method other than the standard default formula, which is (wholesale acquisition cost minus maximum fair price) times quantity.
action: Review the refund calculation if reconciliation is needed.

title: Refund Not Available; Contact Manufacturer
plain: A refund cannot be provided for this claim right now. The provider must contact the manufacturer directly to check refund eligibility.
action: Contact the manufacturer directly about refund eligibility.

title: Manufacturer Reimbursement Pending Corrected PDE
plain: The manufacturer cannot reimburse this claim until Part D submits corrected prescription drug event data to CMS. CMS must validate the maximum fair price first.
action: Ensure corrected Part D PDE data is submitted to CMS.

title: Beneficiary Did Not Elect Hospice
plain: Payer records show this patient has not elected the hospice benefit, which may affect payment for hospice-related services on this claim.
action: Verify hospice election status and correct the claim if needed.

title: Multiple EVV Visits for Date/Time
plain: More than one electronic visit verification record was found for the same date and time. The payer cannot accept duplicate visit data for this claim.
action: Review EVV records and correct any duplicate visit data.

title: California AB-72 Claim Pricing
plain: This claim was priced and processed under California's AB-72 health coverage rules.
action: No action — informational.

title: Predetermination Not Allowed by Plan
plain: The member's plan does not permit predetermination for services.
action: Do not request predetermination for these services.

title: Third Party Will Pay Provider
plain: The third party will pay the provider and will reimburse you for covered services.
action: Coordinate with the third-party payer and follow COB requirements.

title: 340B Refund Recalculated
plain: An alternative refund was calculated because the maximum fair price is lower than the 340B ceiling price.
action: Review the refund calculation and 340B pricing.

title: No Refund for Compounded Drug
plain: CMS excludes prescription drug event records for compounded drugs, so no refund is due.
action: No action — informational.

title: Out-of-Pocket Maximum Met
plain: The family or member has met their out-of-pocket maximum, so cost sharing may no longer apply.
action: Verify remaining patient responsibility and adjust balances if needed.

title: Payment Held for Contract Talks
plain: Payment to the provider is on hold while a contract is being negotiated or renegotiated.
action: Wait for contract resolution or contact the payer's contracting area.

title: Appeal Filing Time Expired
plain: The deadline to file a reconsideration or appeal for this claim has passed.
action: Check for any exception, but the appeal timeframe has ended.

title: Missing Primary Care Dentist
plain: The claim is missing the primary care dentist's information.
action: Submit the missing primary care dentist information.

title: MAO Payment Responsibility Determined
plain: This is not a denial; the Medicare Advantage Organization has made a payment responsibility determination.
action: No action — informational.

title: MAO Decision Pending
plain: This is not a denial; the MAO has not yet decided payment responsibility for the service.
action: Wait for the MAO's payment responsibility determination.

title: MAO Denied Responsibility
plain: The MAO determined it had no payment responsibility for the service when the encounter was submitted.
action: Review the denial and appeal if appropriate.

title: MAO Partially Denied Lines
plain: The MAO denied payment responsibility for some, but not all, service lines.
action: Review the denied lines and appeal if appropriate.

title: Missing or Invalid X-Ray
plain: The x-ray is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid x-ray.

title: Missing or Invalid Dental X-Ray
plain: The bitewing or periapical x-ray is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete and valid bitewing or periapical x-ray.

title: Missing or invalid photos
plain: A required photo is missing, or the photo sent is incomplete or invalid.
action: Submit complete, valid photo documentation.

title: Missing or invalid quadrant identifier
plain: The claim is missing a valid quadrant identifier, or the one provided is incomplete or invalid.
action: Add or correct the quadrant identifier and resubmit.

title: Missing or invalid bitewing/periapical x-rays
plain: Required pre-operative and/or post-operative bitewing or periapical x-rays are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit valid pre- and/or post-operative bitewing or periapical x-rays.

title: Missing or invalid pre/post full mouth x-ray
plain: Required pre-operative and/or post-operative full mouth x-rays are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit valid pre- and/or post-operative full mouth x-rays.

title: Missing or invalid pre/post photos
plain: Required pre-operative and/or post-operative photos are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit valid pre- and/or post-operative photos.

title: Missing or invalid full mouth x-ray
plain: A required full mouth x-ray is missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit a complete, valid full mouth x-ray.

title: Patient no longer Medicaid/QMB eligible
plain: This alert indicates the patient is no longer enrolled as a Medicaid or Qualified Medicare Beneficiary.
action: Verify the patient's current eligibility and coverage before billing or appealing.

title: Medicare multiple procedure payment reduction
plain: Medicare identified this service code as the secondary or tertiary procedure, so payment was reduced under the Multiple Procedure Payment Reduction (MPPR) rule.
action: Review the remittance to see how the MPPR reduction was applied; no resubmission is needed.

title: Service line denial threshold exceeded
plain: The payer has denied this service line because it exceeded a set denial threshold.
action: Review the denial and contact the payer for next steps.

title: Do not resubmit; automatic reprocessing
plain: This alert tells you not to send the claim again because the payer will automatically reprocess it.
action: Do not resubmit; wait for automatic reprocessing.

title: Peer-to-peer review available
plain: This alert says the provider may contact the payer to request a peer-to-peer review.
action: Contact the payer to request a peer-to-peer review if appropriate.

title: Missing or invalid pre/post x-ray
plain: Required pre-operative and/or post-operative x-rays are missing, incomplete, or invalid.
action: Submit valid pre- and/or post-operative x-rays.
